Edit Reels from the footage we send you

Plan and publish a consistent flow of posts, stories and Reels — the account should never go quiet

Follow our brand book. We have one, and we expect it to be used.

Create simple graphics in Canva: schedules, announcements, competition results, coach profiles

Set up, run and optimise Meta ads aimed at booking trial lessons

Report weekly: what was published, what performed, ad spend, cost per lead, and what is planned next



Platforms: Instagram and
 are the priority. TikTok is secondary. YouTube is not in scope for now.



What success looks like

Content shipped on time, every week, without being chased

Cost per booked trial lesson going down over time

Reels held to the end and saved, not just seen

Growth from our real audience and city



Specific targets will be agreed with you in the first month.



Requirements



Essential



Strong short-form video editing — you will be asked to show Reels you personally edited, not ones your team made

Hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience with real budgets, and the numbers to back it up

Written English strong enough for parent-facing captions

Reliable weekly availability and a clear response time during Abu Dhabi hours



Desirable



Canva

Experience with lead generation or working alongside a sales team

Kids' sports, dance, education or family brands

Arabic

One thing we ask you to be straight about



We know good specialists manage several accounts. That is normal and we are fine with it.



What we are not fine with is being the account that gets done last. Tell us how many accounts you currently run and how you protect your deadlines. A clear, realistic answer counts in your favour.



How to apply



Send us:



One Reel you edited yourself that you are proud of — and why it worked

Two or three accounts you currently manage — links, and what you specifically do on each

One paid campaign you ran — budget, result, cost per lead

Your toolkit — what you edit in, what you design in, and roughly how you work from raw footage to a published Reel

How many accounts you manage right now, and your available hours per week

Your rate and what is included



Test task

Shortlisted candidates receive a folder of our real footage and a short brief. You send back one Reel and one story set.

Applications without a Reel you personally edited will not be reviewed.

title: Online Fitness Coach – Client Check-ins, Program Updates & Retention (Full-Time)
description:
FULL-TIME | LONG-TERM | WORK FROM HOME | $600-$900/month



We run an online fitness coaching business with around 140 active clients. Our head coach is at capacity. Clients are waiting too long for replies, check-ins are slipping, and some people who paid for a year have barely heard from us. That is the problem you are being hired to fix.



This is a real coaching seat, not a data-entry VA role. You will own a book of clients and be the person they hear from every week.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run weekly check-ins for your assigned clients: review their numbers, photos and training logs, then write a specific reply that tells them what to change

- Answer client messages inside the coaching app (TrainHeroic) and keep response time under 12 hours

- Adjust training programs and nutrition targets based on what the check-in data actually shows

- Get on short video calls with clients when a message will not cut it

- Spot the clients going quiet before they go quiet, and pull them back in

- Keep clean notes on every client so nothing gets lost



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Real coaching experience. You have personally taken clients through fat loss or muscle gain and can talk about what you changed and why

- Solid grasp of programming and nutrition: progressive overload, deficits and surpluses, macros, how to adjust when someone stalls

- Excellent written English. You are the voice of the brand every single week

- Comfortable on camera and on calls with US-based clients

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to take calls, and hours that overlap the US

- Organised. Managing 40+ clients at once without dropping anyone is the actual skill here



NICE TO HAVE

- A certification (NASM, ISSA, ACE, or similar)

- Experience inside TrainHeroic, Trainerize, or a similar coaching app

- Your own training background



THE DETAILS

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- $600-$900 per month depending on experience, paid monthly

- Long-term. We want someone who grows into a lead coach role, not a three-month stopgap

- Fully remote



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include all of the following in your application. Applications that skip these get deleted:



1. How many clients have you coached at once, and in which app?

2. Describe one client you coached from start to finish. What was their starting point, what did you change along the way, and where did they end up?

3. A client has not logged a workout in 10 days and is not answering messages. Write out exactly what you would send them.

4. What are your working hours in US Eastern Time?



Start your application with the word COACH so we know you read this to the end. Shortlisted applicants will be asked for a short video introduction.

I create a high volume of short-form content and need someone who can consistently turn RAW SLOG3 footage into polished, high-quality edits with a fast turnaround.



Requirements



Experienced with DaVinci Resolve and/or Adobe Premiere Pro



Comfortable working with Sony S-Log3 footage



Strong understanding of color correction and color grading



Able to apply LUTs that I provide or color grade footage yourself



Strong eye for cinematic gym/fitness editing



Good at clip selection, sequencing, match cuts, pacing, transitions, and creating aesthetically pleasing edits



Experience editing fitness, apparel, lifestyle, or brand content



Reliable communication and ability to follow instructions



Turnaround time under 12 hours



Available for consistent, high-volume work



Able to deliver finished content every day



I will provide high-quality raw footage, including S-Log3 footage, along with my LUTs when needed. Projects will primarily involve cinematic fitness, lifestyle, apparel, and branded content, including showcasing brands such as Mentality.



TWO TEST EDITS REQUIRED



You will be required to complete TWO test edits before being officially hired for ongoing work.

Clip selection



Match cuts and transitions



Pacing



Overall visual quality



Ability to follow instructions

DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT WILLING TO COMPLETE TWO TEST EDITS UNDER THESE TERMS.

Pay

title: Senior Brand & Web Designer
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Brand & Web Designer to help us refresh the branding and redesign the websites for two established Australian FMCG company brands.



This is a project-based role for someone with strong brand identity, art direction and website/UI design experience. Experience in FMCG, food, retail or consumer brands is highly preferred.



We’re looking for someone with a modern, distinctive design style who can bring their own creative thinking to the project — not simply execute a supplied brief.



About the Project:

The project involves developing a Brand Guidelines Book and website redesign for each of our two company brands.



Brand Guidelines

The existing logos are already established, so this is not a complete rebrand or new logo design project.



The existing brand foundations will be retained and evolved.



The work will focus on developing and refining areas such as:

Colour palette

Typography

Graphic elements and motifs

Visual language

Photography/imagery direction

Iconography

Digital applications

Website visual direction

Brand usage guidelines



We will provide an existing brand/creative brief and relevant assets as a starting point.



We’re looking for a designer who can interpret the brief and use their own design expertise to develop a cohesive, contemporary visual system.



Website Redesign

The existing websites contain much of the required content, so the focus is largely on restructuring and redesigning the existing pages to make them more modern, engaging and visually distinctive.



The website work will include:

Redesigning existing webpages

Improving content hierarchy and layouts

Developing concepts for some new pages

Improving product and brand presentation

Applying the new Brand Guidelines consistently

Improving the overall UX

Developing a cohesive visual language across the website



We already have content direction, wireframes and initial concepts prepared.



These are intended to communicate the structure and objectives of the website, not to dictate the final design.



We want to work collaboratively with the designer and welcome recommendations around UX, layout, visual hierarchy, page concepts and creative direction.



If you see a better way of approaching something, we want you to tell us.



Visual Direction:

We’re looking for a modern, premium, fresh and visually-led website with strong typography, distinctive layouts, art-directed imagery, product storytelling and engaging visual hierarchy.



Visual references:

Acho Que Bueno: 

OLIPOP: 





These are visual references, not templates to copy. We’re interested in their level of art direction, composition, typography and brand expression.



Our websites are corporate FMCG websites rather than e-commerce, so the design should feel engaging and contemporary while working effectively for both B2B and consumer audiences.



What We’re Looking For -

Must have:

Senior-level branding/graphic design experience

Strong portfolio demonstrating brand identity and visual systems

Strong website design experience

Excellent typography and layout skills

Experience creating Brand Guidelines

Strong visual/art direction skills

Good understanding of UI/UX

Ability to develop concepts rather than simply execute instructions

Strong attention to detail

Good communication and collaborative working style

Available to start immediately



Highly preferred:

FMCG / food / retail / consumer brand experience

UI/UX experience

Corporate/B2B website experience

WordPress experience

Ability to design and build websites in WordPress

Experience working with international/multi-market brands

WordPress is a bonus



It would be ideal if you can take the project from:

Brand → Website Design → UI/UX → WordPress Development



If you are a strong senior brand/web designer who can work alongside a separate WordPress developer, we would still love to see your portfolio.

This is **not a basic list-building or data-entry role**.



We need someone who has personally helped generate **qualified B2B sales appointments** for agencies, BPOs, outsourcing companies, SaaS companies, consulting firms, or other B2B service businesses.



## What You'll Do



You’ll help manage the outbound process from prospect identification through appointment booking, including:

* Finding the correct decision-makers

* Building and verifying targeted prospect lists

* Creating segmented cold
 and LinkedIn campaigns

* Writing relevant outreach and follow-ups

* Managing replies and qualifying interested prospects

* Booking qualified sales appointments

* Tracking everything properly in our CRM

* Reviewing campaign performance and improving what isn't working



We are **not interested in blasting thousands of generic leads**.



We want to reach companies where there is a clear reason for us to start a conversation.



For example, a company actively hiring multiple customer support representatives may already have a capacity problem and an approved budget. Your job is to identify opportunities like this, understand the likely buying situation, and reach the right person with a relevant message.

 platforms such as Smartlead or Instantly

 verification tools

Experience generating opportunities for **outsourcing, BPO, managed services, agencies, SaaS, or professional services** is a strong advantage.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands:



**Buying signal → right company → right decision-maker → relevant outreach → qualified conversation.**



## Please Answer These 3 Questions

title: Civil/Structural Engineer - Report Production Team for US Engineering Firm (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Remote Civil/Structural Engineer – Engineering Report Production

Full-Time Independent Contractor | Long-Term Position | Monday-Friday, U.S. Central Time

Job Overview

Thomas Engineering Consultants (TEC), a U.S.-based engineering firm specializing in residential foundation evaluations and related civil/structural engineering services, is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Civil or Structural Engineer to join our Engineering Report Production Team.

This is a full-time, long-term remote independent contractor position. The selected candidate will work alongside two existing production team members and will be responsible for converting field data collected by TEC engineers and field personnel into accurate, professional, substantially complete engineering reports for final review by the licensed professional engineer.

This is not simply an AutoCAD drafting position. The role includes AutoCAD drafting, processing foundation elevation surveys, engineering calculations, report preparation, repair drawings, historical data comparisons, technical documentation, and quality-control review.

TEC produces multiple engineering reports each business day. Reliability, communication, organization, accuracy, and accountability are therefore essential.

Primary Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include:

Review field sketches, measurements, foundation elevation data, photographs, inspection notes, previous engineering reports, repair documentation, and construction information.

Convert hand-drawn field sketches and measurements into accurate, scaled residential floor plans using AutoCAD.

Plot foundation elevation measurements on scaled floor plans.

Prepare foundation elevation survey drawings for inclusion in professional engineering reports.

Prepare topographic-style elevation drawings, profiles, cross sections, slope diagrams, and other engineering exhibits.

Prepare drawings identifying distress locations, prior repairs, proposed repair locations, trees, drainage conditions, plumbing information, utilities, and other relevant site conditions.

Review previous foundation surveys and overlay or compare historical data with current measurements.

Prepare foundation repair plans and remedial repair drawings based on direction from the licensed professional engineer.

Enter field data into TEC spreadsheets, calculation worksheets, templates, and production systems.

Assist with foundation deflection, tilt, differential elevation, slope, and related calculations using established TEC procedures.

Review calculations for accuracy and consistency with field data.

Organize photographs and field observations for inclusion in engineering reports.

Prepare draft report narratives using TEC templates, terminology, and technical standards.

Combine drawings, calculations, photographs, observations, recommendations, appendices, and supporting information into complete report packages.

Review geotechnical information, plumbing documentation, previous repair information, construction drawings, and other technical documents when provided.

Assist with preparation of site plans, drainage drawings, repair details, and other engineering exhibits.

Maintain accurate report revisions and file organization.

Perform detailed quality-control review before reports are submitted for final engineering review.

Identify missing information, inconsistent measurements, drafting errors, calculation errors, or conflicting field data.

Communicate questions promptly rather than making unsupported assumptions.

Track assigned reports and maintain accountability for daily deliverables.

Coordinate production priorities, revisions, and report status with the rest of the team.

AutoCAD Requirements

Strong AutoCAD proficiency is required.

TEC currently uses AutoCAD LT for its standard drafting and report-production workflow.

The candidate should be proficient in:

Scaled floor plans

Layers and blocks

Dimensions and annotations

Polylines and hatching

Layouts and plotting

Engineering exhibits

Repair plans

Elevation drawings

Drawing revisions

CAD file organization

The candidate must be able to take a field sketch containing measurements, elevations, and notes and efficiently convert it into a clean, professional engineering drawing.

Preferred Advanced Surface Modeling Experience

Advanced three-dimensional surface modeling is not required, but it would be a significant additional qualification.

TEC collects numerous relative elevation measurements throughout residential foundations. These points are distributed across scaled floor plans in a manner similar to a small topographic survey.

A candidate who can convert these elevation points into a three-dimensional surface, TIN surface, or contour plan would bring an additional capability to TEC.

Relevant software may include:

AutoCAD Civil 3D

Autodesk Revit

Other surveying, civil engineering, or surface-modeling software capable of creating triangulated surfaces or contours from elevation data

Because TEC currently uses AutoCAD LT, TEC does not presently maintain Civil 3D or Revit as part of its standard production software. A candidate offering this additional capability would need to have appropriate access to the required software.

Experience in the following areas would be especially valuable:

Importing or entering XYZ or point-elevation data

Creating TIN or triangulated surfaces

Generating contours from elevation data

Editing or refining surfaces

Evaluating high and low areas

Creating profiles and cross sections

Comparing multiple elevation datasets

Preparing three-dimensional engineering exhibits

Again, these capabilities are preferred, not required.

Engineering and Technical Knowledge

The successful candidate should be comfortable working with concepts involving:

Residential slab-on-ground foundations

Post-tensioned concrete foundations

Conventionally reinforced concrete foundations

Foundation elevations

Differential movement

Deflection

Tilt

Settlement, subsidence, and heave

Expansive soils

Soil moisture variation

title: Cheff of Staff - Ecommerce Operations
description:
What We’re Really Looking For

You’ve walked the path. You’ve managed ecommerce businesses, coordinated marketing campaigns, dealt with Amazon listing issues at 2am, and know what breaks when you scale. You don’t just manage projects — you understand the business.



This isn’t a “run meetings and update trackers” role. You’ll work directly with founders to take ownership of the business workflows, bring order to chaos, and use tech/AI to create leverage wherever possible. Every team, every project, every cross-functional handoff — you’re the one making sure it all moves.



The Role

You’ll be the operational backbone that turns strategy into reality across our ecommerce, marketing, catalogue, and product teams.

Reporting: Directly to Founders

Type: Leadership role with full operational ownership



What You’ll Actually Do

- Own End-to-End Execution

- Lead cross-functional projects from idea to launch across ecommerce channels, marketing campaigns, product launches, and catalogue management

- Define what needs to happen, by when, and by whom — then make sure it actually happens

- Break down founder vision into executable roadmaps with clear milestones and accountability

- Unblock teams in real-time and keep things moving fast



Marketing Team Coordination & Execution

- Work closely with the marketing team on campaign planning, creative workflows, and launch coordination

- Understand marketing fundamentals (CAC, ROAS, funnel optimization) enough to have intelligent conversations and catch issues early

- Coordinate between creative, copywriting, paid ads, email, and content teams

- Manage marketing project timelines from brief to execution to measurement

- Bridge the gap between marketing goals and operational reality



Build Structure (Without Bureaucracy)

- Create simple, effective project frameworks and SOPs that actually get used

- Set up tracking systems that give founders visibility without drowning them in reports

- Establish rituals (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews) that drive results, not just meetings

- Document processes as you go so knowledge doesn’t live in your head



Leverage Technology & Automation

- Manage projects and workflows through Asana

- Spot repetitive work and automate it (Zapier, Make, AI tools, n8n)

- Stay current on AI and automation trends; test what gives us an edge

- Push the team toward tech-enabled efficiency



Cross-Functional Leadership

- Coordinate across ecommerce, marketing, catalogue, creative, and support teams

- Translate business priorities into clear action plans with owners

- Run productive meetings that end with decisions and next steps

- Manage internal tea
mbers, contractors, and agency partners



Drive Results & Accountability

- Anticipate risks before they become problems

- Ensure projects ship on time, within scope, and actually move the business forward

- Provide weekly updates to founders with real insight, not just status reports

- Own outcomes, not just outputs



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

- You’ve taken ownership of 3–5 active initiatives and brought clarity to what was chaos

- Marketing team projects are running smoother with clear workflows and timelines

- Founders have visibility into what’s happening without having to ask

- You’ve implemented 2–3 automations that save the team hours every week

- The team actually uses the systems you’ve built



You’re a Great Fit If You Have

Must-Haves

- 8–12 years working in ecommerce or digital businesses (agency, brand, or marketplace side)

- Direct experience managing ecommerce operations on platforms like Shopify, Amazon, Wayfair, or Walmart

- Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals and campaign execution — you’ve coordinated marketing teams or projects before

- Startup or high-growth company experience where you wore multiple hats and figured things out

- Hands-on experience with project management tools (Asana strongly preferred)

- Track record of building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — not just operating within existing ones

- Proven ability to lead and manage people with real authority — not just coordinate

- Track record of getting things done in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

- Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)

- Experience managing remote teams across time zones

- Tech-savvy mindset — comfortable with new tools and AI/automation



Bonus Points

- Experience working directly with founders or C-suite as their operational right hand

- Background in catalogue management, product launches, or creative operations

- Hands-on experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, ChatGPT, n8n)

- Knowledge of SEO, marketplaces, or ecommerce analytics

- Experience scaling a business from early stage — you’ve seen what breaks at $1M, $5M, $10M



Tools You’ll Work With

- Project & Collaboration: Asana, Notion, Slack, Loom, Google Workspace

- Ecommerce Platforms: Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, marketplace dashboards, ERP/OMS tools

- Automation & AI: Zapier, Make, n8n, ChatGPT, various AI tools



Work Setup

This is a fully remote role. You must have:

- Your own reliable laptop/desktop system

- Stable internet connection

- Professional home office setup

- Company-issued hardware is not provided.



Why Join our Company?

- Direct Founder Access — You’ll work directly with founders who value execution over bureaucracy. Your voice matters.

- High Ownership — This isn’t a “wait for instructions” role. You’ll own real business outcomes and shape how we operate.

- Remote Flexibility — Work from anywhere with flexible hours, as long as you have EST overlap for key collaborations.

- Fast-Paced Growth — We’re scaling quickly across channels. You’ll see the direct impact of your work on revenue and growth.

- Tech-Forward Culture — We embrace automation, AI, and smart systems. If you love finding better ways to work, you’ll thrive here.

- No Micromanagement — Clear expectations, full autonomy, and trust. We hire adults and treat them like adults.

title: Technical Operator — Funnels, Email, Tracking & AI Automation
description:
ABOUT US

We're a fast-growing US-based education company running live seminars (100+ person rooms), multi-day retreats, a premium membership, and a growing line of online programs. The founder is a teacher and creator, not a tech person — which is exactly why this role exists. You will be the one person who knows how all of our systems fit together and keeps them running.



THE ROLE

You own the technical side of the business, end to end:



- Funnels & pages — maintain and ship landing pages, opt-in flows and checkout pages (our current funnels are built in Replit).

-
 — build and manage automations, sequences, tags and segments in Kit (ConvertKit).

- Tracking & reporting — make sure every funnel is measured: opt-ins, cost per lead, community joins, calls booked, show rate, sales. Keep one simple weekly scorecard current.

- Ads plumbing — pixels, conversion events, UTM discipline (you set up the tracking; a separate person runs the ads).

- AI agents & automations — run and maintain our AI workflows (Claude, Perplexity, Zapier/Make and similar). Keep them pointed at real goals, catch when they stall, fix what breaks.

- Tool hygiene — logins, integrations, payments connections, domains/DNS basics (Cloudflare), and documentation so nothing lives only in your head.

- Handoffs — take over systems from outside agencies and document them.



You'll receive clear written specs for new builds. What we need from you is ownership: you notice what's broken before anyone asks, and you tell us plainly what's done and what isn't.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

- 2+ years building and maintaining funnels and
 automation for coaches, course creators or info-product businesses

- Hands-on with Kit/ConvertKit (or ActiveCampaign / GoHighLevel and happy to learn Kit), Zapier or Make, and web page builders

- Comfortable in Replit or with basic HTML/CSS/JS — enough to edit, deploy and debug pages (you don't need to be a software engineer)

- You already use AI tools daily in your work, and have built at least one automation or agent workflow

- You understand conversion tracking (Meta pixel, conversion events, UTMs)

- Clear written English; you document as you go

- Emotionally mature: our programs deal with relationships, intimacy and personal growth. You must be comfortable and professional with that subject matter.



BONUS

- Experience with live-event or high-ticket funnels (seminar registration, application → call booking)

- Stripe, Cloudflare, Airtable/Notion

- You've taken over a messy tech stack before and made it calm



HOURS & PAY

- Full-time, 8 hrs/day, with at least 4 hours overlapping US Eastern business hours

- $800–1,400/month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses as the business grows

- Long-term role on a growing team



HOW TO APPLY

1. Subject line: "Operator — [your name]" (applications without this are not reviewed)

2. A 2–3 minute Loom/video: walk us through one funnel or automation you built and maintained — what it did, what broke, how you fixed it

3. List the tools you're strongest in, with years of experience in each

4. Short answer: "A funnel's opt-ins dropped 40% overnight. What are the first five things you check?"



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid test task (~2 hours): audit a live funnel and write up what you'd fix first.

title: Event Operations & Logistics Coordinator
description:
Pay: $5–$7 USD/hour

Hours: 10–20 hours per week

Schedule: Part-time, ongoing through January 2027, with potential to continue

Location: Remote

Time zone: Some overlap with U.S. Mountain Time required



About the Role



We are producing a multi-night immersive masquerade event series in Colorado, USA in January 2027.



The events will include live music, DJs, dance, food and beverage, performers, artists, interactive experiences, VIP hospitality, community partners, sponsors, and multiple event spaces.



We already have venues, vendors, performers, committee members, and other team members involved.



We are looking for a highly organized Event Operations & Logistics Coordinator who can help bring all of the moving pieces together and make sure important details do not fall through the cracks.



This is primarily a remote coordination and project-management role.



You will work closely with the Founder / Executive Producer and help turn meetings, ideas, vendor conversations, and creative plans into organized timelines, checklists, assignments, and operational plans.



Your Main Responsibilities



You will help manage and coordinate areas such as:



Master event timeline and planning calendar

Project task tracking

Vendor coordination and follow-up

Venue requirements

Catering and bar logistics

Performer and entertainment logistics

Arrival times and schedules

Load-in and load-out planning

Event setup and breakdown planning

Run-of-show development

Event-day staffing plans

Captain and team assignments

Guest-flow planning

VIP and general admission operations

Green rooms and performer areas

Equipment and rental tracking

Insurance / COI tracking

Vendor contact sheets

Event checklists

Meeting notes and action items

Following up on missing information

Identifying potential operational problems before they become urgent

A Very Important Part of the Role



You will act as the bridge between our remote planning team and the people physically running the events in Colorado.



Our on-site lead, Olimpia, will act as the general/executor during setup and event days.



Your job will be to help make sure she and the rest of the event team have a clear operational plan before the event begins.



For example:



Who arrives when?

Who is responsible for each area?

Where does each vendor go?

When do performers arrive?

Who handles check-in?

Who handles VIP?

Who is responsible for each activation?

What needs to happen during setup?

What happens if something changes?

Who does each person report to?



The goal is for the event team to have clear instructions and systems so the Founder does not have to personally coordinate every detail.



Who We Are Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized

Reliable

Proactive

Detail-oriented

Comfortable managing many moving pieces

Strong with follow-up

Comfortable communicating with vendors

Able to create clear systems and checklists

Good at turning conversations into tasks

Comfortable working independently

Able to notice missing information

Calm when plans change

Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

Able to prioritize urgent vs. non-urgent work



We are especially interested in people who do not simply wait for instructions.



If you notice:



“We are missing the caterer arrival time”



or



“This performer has not provided technical requirements yet,”



we want you to identify that and follow up.



Experience We Would Love



Experience in any of the following is helpful:



Event coordination

Event planning

Weddings

Conferences

Festivals

Hospitality

Production coordination

Project management

Vendor management

Executive or project-based virtual assistance

Operations coordination



You do not need to be a senior event producer.



Someone with excellent organizational and project-management skills who is eager to learn event operations could also be a strong fit.



Tools



You should be comfortable with:



Google Sheets

Google Docs

Google Drive

Gmail

Zoom / Google Meet

WhatsApp

Project-management tools



Experience with Canva is helpful but not required.



If you already have project-management systems that you like, we are open to your recommendations.



Hours & Availability



We expect approximately 10 hours per week initially.



This may increase to 15–20 hours per week as the January events approach.



Some weekday availability during U.S. Mountain Time is important for meetings and vendor coordination.



You do not need to work U.S. hours all day.



We mainly need a reasonable amount of overlap.



Event Dates



The current primary event dates are in January 2027 in Colorado, USA.



The busiest planning period will likely be:



October 2026 through January 2027



You will work remotely with the team executing the events locally.



Compensation



$5–$7 USD per hour, depending on experience.



There may be an opportunity for increased responsibility and continued work after the January events if the relationship is a strong fit.



To Apply



Please answer all of the following:



Tell me briefly about yourself.

What experience do you have with event coordination, operations, project management, or complex VA work?

Tell me about one event or project that had many moving pieces. What were you responsible for?

What tools do you normally use to organize projects?

How do you make sure deadlines and follow-ups do not get forgotten?

How would you handle a vendor who has not responded and an important deadline is approaching?

How many hours per week are you currently available?

What hours are you normally available in Philippine Time?

Are you comfortable attending occasional meetings during U.S. Mountain Time?

What hourly rate are you requesting?



Please begin your application with:



LUMINARY OPERATIONS



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



About Us



The Luminary Masquerade is being developed as an elevated, immersive event experience combining music, movement, art, hospitality, mystery, masks, light and shadow.



We are building a collaborative team where artists and performers are encouraged to bring their own creativity into the larger story.



We are looking for someone who enjoys creating order behind ambitious creative projects and who takes pride in helping a team execute something memorable.

title: Sales & Virtual Assistant / Operations Specialist
description:
Sales & Virtual Assistant / Operations Specialist



Location: Remote

Job Type: Part-Time / Full-Time

Schedule: Flexible — with availability during designated U.S. business hours



We’re looking for a proactive, versatile Sales & Virtual Assistant / Operations Specialist who can help take work off our team’s plate and take ownership of tasks that we either don’t have time for, don’t specialize in, or simply don’t want to spend our time doing.



This is a hybrid role for someone who is comfortable wearing multiple hats — from cold calling and lead follow-up to administrative support, automation, systems, and SOP development.



What You’ll Do



Sales & Lead Generation



Make outbound cold calls to prospective customers and leads

Follow up with leads through phone, text, and

Qualify prospects and identify potential students/customers

Schedule appointments for qualified prospects

Follow up consistently with warm and interested leads

Assist with sales conversations and, for the right candidate, close enrollments and convert prospects into paid students

Track leads, conversations, follow-ups, and results inside our CRM



Virtual Assistant & Administrative Support



Handle day-to-day administrative tasks

Organize information, files, and business processes

Manage follow-ups and recurring tasks

Assist with scheduling and communication

Research information and complete assigned projects

Help keep internal systems organized and up to date



Systems, Automation & SOPs



Help document and improve business processes

Create and maintain SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

Help organize our knowledge and internal systems using tools such as Obsidian

Identify repetitive tasks that can be automated

Assist with setting up workflows, automations, and CRM processes

Look for ways to make the business more efficient and reduce manual work

Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is:



Self-motivated and proactive

Comfortable working independently

Strong in communication and follow-up

Comfortable making cold calls

Organized and detail-oriented

Tech-savvy and willing to learn new software

Able to understand processes and turn them into clear SOPs

Comfortable working with CRMs and automation tools

Able to take direction but also recognize what needs to be done without constantly being told

Reliable and accountable for assigned tasks

Sales Experience Is a Major Plus



If you have proven experience as a sales closer, we especially want to hear from you.



The ideal candidate will not only generate and qualify leads but will eventually be able to take qualified prospects through the sales process and close paid student enrollments.



Tools & Technology



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



GoHighLevel (GHL)

CRM systems

AI tools

Automation platforms

Obsidian or other knowledge-management systems

Google Workspace

Slack

SOP/process documentation tools

Sales and communication platforms

Why Join Us?



This is an opportunity to become an important part of a growing team. Rather than simply completing a checklist of VA tasks, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of real business functions, improve our systems, and directly contribute to sales and growth.



If you're someone who can say, “Give me the task, I'll figure it out and get it done,” we'd love to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Content Editor for Female Personal Brand — Long-Term
description:
I’m looking for a creative short-form content editor to help me grow my personal brand on Instagram and TikTok.



I will provide raw talking videos and lifestyle/B-roll footage. I need someone who can do more than simply edit clips. I want someone who understands storytelling, hooks and retention and can recognize the strongest parts of raw footage.



You’ll help with:



* Editing Instagram Reels/TikToks

* Finding the strongest hook within raw footage

* Suggesting alternate hooks

* Cutting unnecessary parts while keeping the content natural

* Adding clean captions/text

* Incorporating lifestyle B-roll

* Occasionally helping turn ideas into carousels



My style is real, editorial, cinematic and personal — not overly edited or “influencer-y.”



I’m looking for someone who wants to learn my voice and potentially become a long-term part of the team.



To apply: Send me 3 examples of short-form content you’ve edited. Then tell me: What makes the first 3 seconds of a Reel keep someone watching?



Please start your application with the word STORY so I know you read this.



Starting part-time with a 30-day trial. Opportunity to grow with the brand.

 + Social Media) for Mobile Coffee & Event Vendor Brands

Write and send personalized cold

Report weekly on

title: AI / Full-Stack Engineer
description:
We’re building and experimenting with developer and AI products and are looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys exploring early-stage ideas.



This isn’t a traditional role where you’ll just receive tickets and implement them. You’ll work directly with the founder to test products, brainstorm ideas, give honest technical feedback, build prototypes, and help us figure out what is worth pursuing.



What you’ll do:



* Test and evaluate early-stage AI/developer products

* Brainstorm directly with the founder

* Give honest technical and product feedback

* Build prototypes and experiments quickly

* Improve existing products and features

* Explore AI agents, LLMs, MCP, and developer infrastructure

* Help turn promising ideas into usable products



What we’re looking for:

title: Google Ads Support Specialist
description:
# Google Ads Support Specialist



**Remote | Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising**



## About Slaymaker Marketing



Slaymaker Marketing is a growing digital advertising agency managing paid-media campaigns for e-commerce and B2B clients. We combine senior-level strategy with hands-on execution across Google, Microsoft, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other advertising platforms.



We value honesty, improvement, respect, ownership, selflessness, and results. We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, pays close attention to detail, and takes responsibility for producing accurate work.



## About the Role



We are hiring a Google Ads Support Specialist to support campaign implementation, optimization, QA, analysis, and reporting across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.



You will work alongside experienced account leads who own client strategy and communication. Your role will be to translate that strategy into accurate campaign execution, monitor account performance, maintain organized documentation, and proactively surface opportunities and concerns.



This role is ideal for someone with strong Google Ads fundamentals who wants to develop into an independent account manager and strategist.



## What You’ll Own Day to Day



* Build and update Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Display, and YouTube campaigns

* Conduct keyword, search-term, competitor, audience, and placement research

* Develop and implement keyword lists, match types, negatives, audiences, and targeting

* Draft and upload responsive search ads, extensions, assets, and other ad variations

* Make approved changes to bids, budgets, targeting, exclusions, and campaign settings

* Monitor spend pacing, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, impression share, and other relevant metrics

* Review search terms and identify negative keywords or expansion opportunities

* Conduct routine account checks and flag unusual performance or delivery changes

* Pull and organize data for client reporting and internal analysis

* Prepare performance notes, insights, and recommended actions before client calls

* Support Google Merchant Center and product-feed troubleshooting

* Maintain campaign naming conventions, labels, tracking templates, and UTMs

* Review conversion actions, attribution settings, URLs, and campaign goals

* Document completed changes, test results, open questions, and next steps

* Implement campaigns and changes in Microsoft Advertising when needed

* Proactively identify opportunities instead of waiting exclusively for assigned tasks



## QA Expectations



Every campaign build or major change must receive complete QA. You will be expected to verify:



* Campaign type, objective, bidding strategy, budget, and schedule

* Keywords, match types, negatives, audiences, and exclusions

* Geographic, demographic, device, network, and language settings

* Ad copy, assets, final URLs, tracking templates, and UTMs

* Conversion actions and campaign-level conversion goals

* Merchant Center products, feed settings, and product-group structures

* Brand exclusions, account-level negatives, and suitability settings

* Naming conventions and reporting consistency

* Alignment with the approved strategy and client instructions



## Required Qualifications



* Hands-on experience building and optimizing Google Ads campaigns

* Strong understanding of Search campaign structures and keyword strategy

* Familiarity with Shopping and Performance Max campaigns

* Ability to interpret performance data and identify meaningful trends

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to pre-launch QA

* Clear written English and dependable internal communication

* Strong organization and time-management skills

* Ability to manage work across multiple accounts and deadlines

* Willingness to document work and communicate progress proactively

* Ability to identify concerns and suggest solutions before escalating them



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience supporting both e-commerce and B2B lead-generation accounts

* Familiarity with Microsoft Advertising and Google Merchant Center

* Experience with GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, Shopify, and HubSpot

* Understanding of conversion tracking and offline conversion imports

* Experience with product feeds and feed-optimization tools

* Familiarity with value-based bidding, attribution, and lifecycle-stage reporting

* Experience working with monthly advertising budgets of $50,000 or more

* Familiarity with project-management and team-communication platforms



## What Success Looks Like



* Campaigns and optimizations are completed accurately and on schedule

* Every launch receives thorough QA

* Search-term reviews and account checks are completed consistently

* Reporting data and call-preparation notes are accurate and useful

* Performance issues are identified and escalated early

* Account leads have clear visibility into completed work and blockers

* Recommendations are supported by data and aligned with client goals

* You gradually progress from execution support toward independent ownership of smaller accounts



## What We’re Looking For



The right person is analytical, dependable, organized, and proactive. You should be comfortable following a defined strategy while also thinking critically about whether the requested implementation makes sense.



We do not want someone who blindly completes tasks. We want someone who checks their work, raises concerns, investigates performance changes, and contributes ideas for improvement.



To apply, please provide:



* A brief overview of your Google Ads experience

* The campaign types and monthly budgets you have managed or supported

* Examples of e-commerce or lead-generation accounts you have worked on

* An example of an optimization or QA issue you identified

* Your experience with GA4, GTM, Merchant Center, and Microsoft Advertising

* Your availability and preferred working hours

*Only apply with a portfolio of your examples*



We're a fast-growing e-commerce supplement brand (health/wellness niche) looking for a skilled video editor to join our creative team long-term.



We produce direct response video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) — this is performance marketing, not brand film. You need to understand pacing, hooks, and retention, not just "make it look nice."



What you'll be doing:

- Generating AI images and video clips to use as B-roll/visuals

Please send:

- A short note on your AI tool stack for image/video generation

- Your typical turnaround time per video



We're looking to build a long-term relationship with the right editor — if this works out, expect consistent, ongoing volume, and good salary.

title: Executive & Personal Assistant to Director
description:
Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | Australian Business Hours

We are looking for a highly capable Executive & Personal Assistant to work directly with the Director of a growing Australian business.

This is not a basic VA or data-entry position.

The purpose of this role is to reduce the Director's administrative workload, keep priorities organised, follow up outstanding matters and make sure important things do not get forgotten or unnecessarily require the Director's involvement.

The right person will eventually understand what they can handle themselves, prepare for a decision, follow up, delegate or escalate.

Responsibilities

- Organise and prioritise the Director's inbox.

- Draft and prepare
s and replies.

- Follow up unanswered
s and outstanding matters.

- Manage calendar, appointments, meetings and interviews.

- Maintain priority, follow-up and decision lists.

- Turn conversations and meetings into clear action items.

- Follow up staff, suppliers and other parties for updates.

- Prepare information before decisions are required.

- Research products, suppliers, travel, services and business matters.

- Compare options and summarise recommendations clearly.

- Assist with travel planning and bookings.

- Organise documents and information.

- Assist with personal appointments and administration when required.

- Keep track of deadlines and commitments.

- Identify tasks that can be taken off the Director's plate.

- Use AI and automation to improve efficiency.

- Maintain strict confidentiality.

- Proactively identify better ways to organise the Director's workload.

What We're Looking For

Essential

- Previous EA/PA experience supporting a business owner, founder, CEO, director or senior executive.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Excellent judgement and common sense.

- Extremely organised.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Concise communication.

- Excellent follow-through.

- Comfortable following up people without being reminded.

- Able to distinguish urgent from merely important.

- Strong Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive and Google Workspace skills.

- Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools.

- Able to research independently and provide recommendations.

- High discretion and confidentiality.

- Proactive rather than waiting for instructions.

What Success Looks Like

The Director should increasingly be able to say:

“Handle it.”



and trust that it will either be completed or brought back with a clear recommendation.

You should not simply forward information.

Instead of:

“You received this
. What should I do?”

we prefer:

“This needs a decision by Friday. I checked the options, recommend B for these reasons, and I've prepared the reply for your approval.”

The objective is to save the Director time and mental workload.

Working Hours

Monday–Friday: Sydney business hours

Occasional flexibility may be required, but regular Saturday work is not currently required.

Pay

US$5–7/hour depending on experience

For an exceptional EA who demonstrates strong judgement, initiative and genuine executive-support experience, we're willing to pay accordingly.

How to Apply

Please answer briefly:

1. Who have you supported previously and what was their position?

2. What responsibilities did you personally take off their plate?

3. How did you manage their inbox, calendar and priorities?

4. Give one real example where you noticed something needed to be done and handled it without being asked.

5. Give one example where you researched something and presented your executive with a recommendation rather than just information.

6. What AI tools do you use and how?

7. Expected hourly rate.

8. Earliest start date.

Please answer from your actual experience. AI may be used to improve grammar or formatting, but generic or invented examples will not be considered. Short, specific answers are preferred.

title: Graphic Designer | Photoshop + Canva + ChatGPT
description:
We are looking for a high-level Graphic Designer to join Chapie, a fast-growing U.S. e-commerce brand.



This is not a basic Canva position. We need someone with strong design judgment who can use Photoshop, Canva, and ChatGPT/AI image tools together to create polished website,
, product, and production assets.



What You’ll Do

Create website banners and promotional graphics

Create
 marketing graphics

Design product launch assets

Create and refine e-commerce product images

Use ChatGPT/AI to generate and modify visual concepts

Clean up AI-generated graphics in Photoshop so they look professional and free of obvious artifacts

Resize and adapt artwork for different products and formats

Prepare production-ready product graphics

Follow our documented production workflow, including PROD-002, PROD-003, and PROD-004

Review your own work carefully before submitting it

Required Skills



You must be strong in:



Adobe Photoshop

Canva

ChatGPT / AI image generation and editing

Graphic design fundamentals

Typography, composition, spacing, and color

E-commerce and website graphics

Image cleanup and retouching

Following exact dimensions and design specifications

Strong written English communication



Adobe Illustrator experience is a plus.



Most Important



We need someone who can follow detailed instructions accurately.



Our production work has specific dimensions, product geometry, formatting requirements, and SOPs. You must be able to read a process, understand it, and complete the work correctly without needing every step re-explained.



You should also be able to receive feedback and not repeat the same mistakes after they have already been corrected.



You’re a Strong Fit If

You have a genuinely strong graphic design portfolio

You can recreate the style and direction of reference images

You notice small visual errors before submitting work

You use AI to speed up design work but do not rely on raw AI outputs

You are comfortable moving between ChatGPT, Photoshop, and Canva

You communicate clearly in English

You are organized and dependable

You can work independently from written SOPs

Do Not Apply If

Your experience is mostly basic Canva templates

You cannot use Photoshop confidently

You submit AI images without cleaning up artifacts

You frequently miss dimensions or written instructions

You need constant supervision

You struggle to understand detailed instructions in English

How to Apply



Please send:



Your portfolio link

3 examples of your best work involving e-commerce, website graphics,
 graphics, product images, or packaging/product design

Rate your skill from 1–10 in:

Photoshop

Canva

ChatGPT / AI image tools

Your hourly rate

Your normal working hours in Philippine Time

A short answer to: How do you use AI in your graphic design workflow without making the final design look AI-generated?



Start your application with the words:



CHAPIE DESIGNER



Applications that do not start with those words will not be reviewed.



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short paid design test.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of the team, not just complete occasional one-off projects.

title: Senior WordPress Developer, Full Time, Long Term
description:
We are an Australian branding and marketing agency managing around 30 WordPress sites for our clients. We are hiring an experienced, motivated WordPress developer to maintain our existing sites and build our new sites.



The role has two parts.



1. Builds and amendments.

New sites and pages from finished designs, plus the day to day queue: content updates, blog posts, events, forms, and on page SEO on everything you publish.



2. Maintenance and security.

Backups, uptime, security hardening, and fixing whatever breaks. Routine plugin updates are handled by another developer, so your focus is the standard, the response, and the builds.



If running a fleet of WordPress websites properly sounds like a job you would actually enjoy, keep reading.



You should have:



WordPress

- 5 or more years of professional WordPress development.

- Strong page builder skills. We use a modern visual builder; if you are good in Elementor, Divi or similar, you will pick ours up quickly.

- Comfortable using ACF and custom fields.

- Solid WordPress security knowledge and good on page SEO habits.



Development

- PHP and JavaScript you can genuinely read and write.

- Methodical debugging when a live site breaks.

- Experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor is a plus. We use them daily.

- Experience building automation systems in tools like Go High Level and Notion is a plus.



How you work

- An incredible eye for detail and for checking over your own work.

- Excellent written English.



Practical

- A reliable computer and a backup internet connection. An Apple Mac is preferred but not essential.

- Available to start within four weeks.



The offer

- Full time, Monday to Friday. Philippine daytime hours work well with our timezone.

- $1,200 to $1,600 USD per month, depending on experience.

- Paid monthly on the 5th of each month.

- Philippine regular holidays, 10 days paid leave, and 13th month pay after your first year.

- Salary review at 12 months.

- Fully remote, long term role.

- The option to work 6 hours a day instead of 8, salary pro rata.



To apply



There are two steps. We only interview candidates who complete both, and interview invitations are based on your application and your assessment results together.



Step 1. 



Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph with the word 'Mango' in your subject line. Start your application by answering the below questions:



1. How many years of professional WordPress development experience do you have?

2. How many years of professional development experience do you have in total?

3. A client site shows a white screen after an update. What are your first five steps?

4. Have you built anything with an AI coding tool? Tell us about the coolest thing: what does it do, and how did you build it? (Optional, but we love seeing this.)



Then include links to three WordPress sites you built or maintain, with a note on what you did on each.



Step 2. 



Complete our online assessment. It takes around one hour: 



Please complete the assessment yourself, without AI tools. The system detects assisted answers and disqualifies them.



We will not review applications without a completed assessment. 



Please contact us only through OnlineJobs.ph; WhatsApp and
 applications are ignored.



Good luck!



Justin - Founder

title: E-commerce Customer Service Specialist – Gorgias & Shopify
description:
Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | Australian Business Hours

We are a growing Australian retail and e-commerce business looking for an experienced E-commerce Customer Service Specialist to join our remote customer support team.

This is a hands-on customer service role primarily using Gorgias and Shopify to assist customers through
 and live chat.

We are looking for someone who does more than simply reply to tickets. You should investigate the issue, find the correct information, take ownership and resolve the customer's enquiry wherever possible.

What You'll Do

- Respond to customer
s and live chats through Gorgias.

- Assist with product, stock, order, delivery and general enquiries.

- Investigate customer orders through Shopify before responding.

- Review order history and previous customer conversations.

- Provide accurate tracking and delivery information.

- Follow up couriers and delivery issues when required.

- Assist with order changes and routine order issues.

- Handle basic returns, refunds and replacements within company procedures.

- Escalate specialist claims or complex issues to the correct person.

- Follow unresolved enquiries through to completion.

- Keep customers updated when waiting for another department, courier or supplier.

- Use tags, macros and ticket statuses correctly.

- Maintain accurate customer and order notes.

- Identify recurring customer issues and report them.

- Suggest improvements to macros, FAQs and customer-service processes.

- Research answers before unnecessarily escalating to management.

- Learn our products, policies and procedures.

What We're Looking For

Essential

- Previous e-commerce customer service experience.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong
 and live-chat experience.

- Strong problem-solving skills.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Good judgement and common sense.

- Strong organisation and follow-up.

- Comfortable handling multiple customer conversations.

- Able to work independently.

- Professional when dealing with difficult customers.

- Willing to take ownership rather than simply pass problems to someone else.

Highly Regarded

Experience with:

- Gorgias

- Shopify

- Zendesk or similar helpdesk platforms

- Australian customers

- order tracking and delivery issues

- returns and refunds

- courier/freight enquiries

What Success Looks Like

We care about quality and resolution, not simply sending as many replies as possible.

You will be assessed on areas including:

- Resolution time

- Customer satisfaction

- Tickets resolved/closed

- Follow-ups completed on time

- Low unnecessary escalation

- Correct use of Gorgias

- Independence and problem-solving

- Customer-service quality

Once fully trained, we would generally expect approximately 25–30+ quality ticket resolutions per day, depending on ticket complexity.

Working Hours

Monday–Friday: Sydney business hours

Saturday: 10:00am–4:00pm Sydney time (optional)

Saturday availability is preferred but not required.

Pay

US$4–6/hour depending on experience

Strong candidates with excellent English and genuine Gorgias + Shopify experience may be offered toward the top of the range.

How to Apply

Please keep your answers short and specific.

1. How many years of e-commerce customer service experience do you have?

2. Have you used Gorgias? If yes, for how long?

3. Have you used Shopify to investigate customer orders?

4. Approximately how many
s/chats/tickets did you handle per day?

5. What customer-service KPIs were you measured on?

6. Give one real example of an enquiry where you didn't immediately know the answer. How did you investigate it and resolve it?

7. Give one real example of a difficult customer issue you personally resolved.

8. What is your expected hourly rate?

9. What is your earliest start date?

Important

We want to understand your actual experience and judgement.

You may use AI tools such as ChatGPT for spelling, grammar or formatting, but your answers must be based on real work you personally performed.

Generic, hypothetical or invented examples will not be considered. We may ask you to explain your examples during an interview.

title: Social Media Strategist & Content Manager Facebook | Instagram | YouTube | Content | Community | Growth
description:
Social Media Strategist & Content Manager



We are looking for a creative, strategic, organized, and hands-on Social Media Strategist & Content Manager who can manage social media from planning and content creation to scheduling, engagement, analytics, and lead generation.



This is not simply a posting role. We are looking for someone who can understand the purpose behind the content, create content that connects with the right audience, and consistently execute the social media plan.



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Experienced in social media management and strategy

* Creative and confident in developing content ideas

* Highly organized and able to manage multiple content calendars

* Strong in copywriting and creating engaging captions

* Able to write strong hooks and calls to action

* Experienced in Instagram and

* Comfortable managing YouTube and YouTube Shorts

* Experienced in creating Reels and short-form video content

* **Strong in video editing. Video editing is a MUST for this role.**

* Experienced with Canva for graphics and social media content

* Comfortable using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar video editing software

* Able to create engaging carousels, graphics, Stories, Reels, and short-form videos

* Understands social media analytics and can use data to improve content

* Understands audience growth and engagement

* Comfortable with community management and responding to social media inquiries

* Strong in written English and able to communicate clearly

* Proactive and able to work independently

* Detail-oriented and able to meet deadlines

* Comfortable working with Trello and keeping tasks organized

* Able to manage content consistently without needing constant reminders

* Willing to bring new ideas and identify opportunities for growth

* Comfortable managing both service-based and course-related content



Responsibilities:



 Social Media Strategy

* Identify content opportunities and trends

* Develop content pillars and themes

* Plan campaigns and promotional content

* Monitor what is working and make adjustments based on performance



Content Planning

* Organize content by platform, topic, audience, and goal

Content Creation



Create and manage:

 posts

* Stories

* Carousels

* Graphics

* Short-form videos

* Educational content

* Promotional content

* Engagement content

* Lead-generation content



Video Editing



**Video editing is a MUST.



You will be responsible for editing short-form video content, including:



* Instagram Reels

*
 videos

* YouTube Shorts

You should be comfortable adding:



* Captions

* Transitions

* Music

Copywriting



* Write captions

* Write CTAs

Content Scheduling

Social Media Analytics

Audience Growth

Engagement & Community Building



* Monitor comments and messages

* Respond to social media inquiries

* Encourage audience conversations

* Engage with relevant accounts and communities

* Identify common audience questions and turn them into content opportunities

Blog Writing



* Research and write blog posts

* Organize upcoming blog topics

* Ensure blogs are published consistently

* Repurpose blog content into social media content



Google Business Profile

* Share educational, promotional, and service-related content

Service Lead Generation



* Create social media content designed to generate organizing service inquiries

* Develop CTAs that encourage potential clients to take action

Course Audience Building

 post → Story → Carousel → Blog topic

title: AI VIDEO EDITOR — SHORT-FORM ADS & AI CONTENT
description:
Remote | Long-Term | Video Ads | AI Video Generation | UGC



We are looking for a **high-level AI Video Editor** to join our creative team on a long-term basis.



You will be creating **high-converting short-form video ads** for an established Dutch e-commerce brand. We are looking for someone who understands that great ad editing is not just about making videos look good — it is about **stopping the scroll, holding attention, and communicating the offer clearly.**



We have a large volume of creatives to produce and are looking for someone who can grow with the brand.



## WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING



You will turn provided scripts, UGC footage, product assets and references into polished advertising creatives.



Your work will include:



* AI-generated creators speaking naturally

* AI-generated B-roll and visual storytelling

* UGC + AI hybrid ads

* Dutch voiceover-based ads

* Fast-paced direct-response advertisements

* Product-focused creatives

* Retargeting/offer-first ads

* Multiple creative variations from the same concept

* English/German variations when required



You will also create and integrate:



* Dynamic captions and text overlays

* Motion graphics

* Sound effects

* Transitions

* Music

* AI-generated visual metaphors

* Product shots

* Lifestyle B-roll

* Voiceovers

* Other visual elements needed to make the ad engaging



## THE EDITING STYLE



We want **high-retention, modern direct-response advertising**.



Think:



* Strong hooks

* Fast but intentional pacing

* Frequent visual changes

* Zero unnecessary dead air

* Kinetic text

* Strong sound design

* Pattern interrupts

* Emotional storytelling

* AI + real UGC combinations

* Visuals that reinforce what is being said

* Constant engagement throughout the video



You should be able to watch a reference ad and understand **why the editing works**, then recreate the underlying style without simply copying it.



## AI TOOLS



You don't need to know every tool below, but experience with AI video generation is highly preferred.



Examples include:



* Arc Ads

* Sora

* Veo

* Kling

* Nano Banana

* Midjourney

* ElevenLabs

* CapCut AI

* Runway

* HeyGen

* Similar AI video/image/voice tools



We care more about your ability to **produce high-quality results** than which specific software you use.



## ABOUT THE BRAND



You will be working on advertising for **Go Gember**, a Dutch ginger juice brand.



The product is 100% pure ginger juice, with the core marketing angle being **convenience + purity**.



The primary audience is 40+.



The brand is energetic, trustworthy, practical, customer-focused and slightly entertaining — **not boring or corporate**.



Our ads focus heavily on the customer's problem, benefits, emotions and desired outcome rather than simply listing product specifications.



## WHAT WE PROVIDE



You will receive:



* Complete scripts

* Dutch UGC footage

* Product photos/videos

* Raw B-roll

* Brand assets

* Reference advertisements

* Creative direction

* Dutch language support



You will be responsible for creating the additional AI assets, B-roll, voiceovers, AI creators, motion graphics, text and sound effects required for the final edit.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You are a strong fit if you:



* Have proven experience editing short-form ads

* Understand retention and direct-response advertising

* Have strong pacing and storytelling instincts

* Can create visually engaging edits without over-editing

* Have experience with AI video/image generation

* Know how to use sound design effectively

* Can match a reference style accurately

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Can follow a script while making smart visual decisions

* Can work independently

* Communicate clearly and reliably

* Are interested in a long-term partnership



**Experience with e-commerce,
/Instagram ads, UGC ads or direct-response advertising is a major advantage.**



Dutch language ability is helpful but **not required**. Scripts and language support will be provided.



## IMPORTANT



This is **not a basic CapCut editing job.**



We are looking for someone who can take a script and think:



"What should the viewer SEE at this exact moment to make this line more interesting?"



You should be comfortable generating AI visuals, finding creative ways to represent concepts, and building an engaging visual story around the voiceover.



 LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the creative team.



The goal is to produce a large volume of advertisements while continuously improving quality, speed and creative performance.



There is potential for increased responsibility and compensation as you become familiar with the brand and consistently deliver strong work.



Quality comes first. We would rather work with a great editor who understands the system than someone who simply produces a high number of mediocre videos.



APPLICATION PROCESS



To apply, please send:



1. **Your name and location**

2. **Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link**

3. **Your preferred editing software**

4. **Your experience with AI video tools**

5. **3–5 examples of your BEST short-form video ads**

6. At least **1 example showing strong AI-generated visuals**, if available

7. Your expected monthly salary/rate

8. How many hours per week you are available

9. Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60 second ad

10. A short answer to this question:



What makes a short-form ad keep someone watching instead of scrolling away?



 IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Start your application with:



"I STOP THE SCROLL."



Applications that don't follow the instructions above may not be considered.



If your portfolio demonstrates the level of editing we're looking for, we'll contact you with the next step.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term creative partner, not just someone looking for occasional editing gigs.

title: Marketing & Events Virtual Assistant for Real Estate Business
description:
# Events + Marketing Coordinator / Virtual Assistant



**Part-Time | 5–10 Hours/Week to Start | Long-Term Opportunity**



I’m a Realtor in Minneapolis, Minnesota, looking for a smart, organized, proactive virtual assistant to help manage the **marketing, events, and behind-the-scenes organization** of my real estate business.



This is not a cold-calling or sales position, and I am not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of tasks every day.



I’m looking for someone who can take a project from me and **own the execution from handoff through completion**.



For example, I might say:



“I want to host a wreath-making event for about 20 clients in November.”



I would choose the concept, overall feel, and who I want to invite. **Marketing + Content**

* Schedule Instagram and
 content

* Organize photos, videos, and marketing assets

* Help create and send
 newsletters

* Maintain
/contact databases

**Organization + Administrative Support**



* Maintain Google Drive folders, spreadsheets, trackers, and databases

* Keep project calendars and deadlines organized

* Collect documents or information when needed

* Follow up on outstanding items

* Create simple systems that make recurring projects easier the next time



This role is primarily **marketing, events, and business organization — not real estate transaction coordination.**



## Who I'm Looking For



You may be a great fit if you are:



* Extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Proactive rather than waiting to be told every next step

* Comfortable researching solutions independently

* A good written communicator

* Able to manage several small projects at once

* Comfortable learning my style and eventually handling recurring projects with minimal direction

* Someone who notices when something hasn't been completed and follows through



Experience with **Canva, Google Workspace, Eventbrite,
 marketing platforms, social-media scheduling, and event coordination** is helpful.



Real estate experience is a bonus, but it is **not required**.



I'm more interested in finding someone with good judgment, strong organization, and the ability to learn my business.



## Hours & Long-Term Potential



This will start at approximately **5–10 hours per week**, with flexibility in when much of the work is completed.



I'm looking for someone I can work with long term. As we develop systems and you learn my business, there may be opportunities to take ownership of more projects and increase your hours.

 marketing platforms, and social-media scheduling tools.
