title: AI Content Creator — Social Media (Short-Form Video + Design) | Full-Time
description:
ABOUT US



We're a small, fast-moving team running several e-commerce / DTC product brands. We sell physical products online and we live and die by social content — TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and paid social.



We're not looking for someone to "post on social media." We're looking for a creator: someone who can take a product, find the angle, write the hook, and ship the asset — using AI tools to move 5x faster than a traditional designer or editor.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Produce short-form video content (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) for our brands — script, visuals, edit, captions, sound

Write scrollstopping hooks and on-screen copy that make people stop in the first 1.5 seconds

Create static assets: product visuals, carousels, ad creatives, story templates

Use AI tools to generate images, video, voiceovers and variations at scale

Adapt one core idea into 5–10 variations to test what converts

Repurpose UGC, reviews and product footage into clean, native-feeling content

Keep each brand visually consistent (we'll give you brand guidelines)

Track what performs, save what works, and iterate — we care about results, not volume for volume's sake



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must have:



Strong eye for design and composition — you notice when spacing, type or color is off

Real understanding of short-form creative: hooks, pacing, retention, pattern interrupts, CTA placement

Hands-on experience with AI creative tools (image, video, voice, copy)

Proficiency in Canva and CapCut (or equivalent)

Good written English — you'll be writing hooks and captions in English

Self-starter: you can take a brief in 3 lines and come back with something good

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing



Tools we use (you don't need all of them, but show us what you know):



Image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Photoshop/Canva

Video: Runway, Veo, Kling, CapCut, Opus Clip

Voice/audio: ElevenLabs

Copy/ideation: ChatGPT, Claude

Design: Canva (Pro)



Nice to have:



Experience creating content for e-commerce or DTC brands

Basic motion graphics

Experience with paid social creative (Meta / TikTok Ads)

Comfortable on camera or with UGC-style editing



WHY YOU'LL LIKE WORKING WITH US



Long-term, stable full-time role — we're building a team, not hiring for one project

Real creative ownership: your ideas get shipped, not buried in approval chains

Direct feedback and fast decisions (small team, no bureaucracy)

We pay for the AI tools and subscriptions you need

Salary review after 3 months based on performance



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — applications that skip this are ignored)



Send your application with:



Subject line: AI Creator — [your favorite AI tool]

A portfolio link (Drive, Behance, Notion, TikTok profile — whatever shows your work). Tell us clearly what YOU made.

A short answer (3–5 sentences): which AI tools do you use in your daily workflow, and for what exactly?

A mini test: pick any physical product (yours or a brand you like) and send us 3 hook ideas you'd use for a TikTok/Reel about it, plus 1 visual you created with an AI tool for it. Rough is fine — we want to see how you think, not a polished campaign.

title: Shopify E-commerce Specialist
description:
Grizzly Mine is preparing to launch a story-driven apparel brand on Shopify. We are looking for a hands-on Shopify e-commerce specialist who can help implement the storefront now and then become the person responsible for its day-to-day operation after launch.



This is not a developer position and it is not a basic product-upload role. We already have the Shopify store, the Ella premium theme, a detailed launch initiative, and an internal configuration guide. The right person will take that direction, execute it carefully inside Shopify, keep the storefront organized and working properly, and coordinate outside specialists when code-based work is required.



The Immediate Assignment

Our initial storefront is built on Shopify using the Ella 6.7.6 theme and the Home 30 POD Store preset. The launch plan intentionally stays inside Shopify and Ella's visual editor: no Edit Code work is expected from this role. The specialist will work from existing documentation and help move the store from its current configuration stage to a customer-ready launch.

• Protect and organize working themes, backups, preview versions, and configuration decisions.

• Configure global theme settings including typography, colors, product-card behavior, swatches, cart behavior, and appropriate feature defaults.

• Build and validate the primary product template using a fully configured print-on-demand product, including color swatches, variant images, size information, product content, and delivery messaging.

• Build and organize collections, filtering, and primary navigation so customers can shop naturally by product and brand collection.

• Assemble the homepage from the approved brand and merchandising direction rather than simply accepting the theme preset as-is.

• Configure supporting pages including About, FAQs, Contact, password/pre-launch, search, 404, and other launch-facing utility pages.

• Review theme widgets and popups and keep unnecessary or misleading urgency features disabled.

• Validate storefront integrations, forms, app embeds, links, mobile behavior, and the preview experience before launch.

• Document important configuration decisions so the storefront can be maintained cleanly over time.



Ongoing Responsibilities After Launch

• Own routine Shopify storefront administration and keep the store accurate, organized, and customer-ready.

• Create and update products, variants, collections, navigation, pages, merchandising, and storefront content as the catalog grows.

• Implement product launches, seasonal updates, promotions, discount configurations, and approved merchandising changes.

• Maintain the theme through safe working practices: duplicate before major changes, use preview themes, test changes, and keep configuration understandable.

• Coordinate Shopify-facing integrations with tools such as Klaviyo, 
, Smile, Gorgias, fulfillment partners, and other approved apps.

• Perform regular QA across desktop and mobile, including product behavior, links, forms, cart flow, app widgets, and storefront presentation.

• Troubleshoot issues, research solutions, work with Shopify/theme/app support, and follow problems through to resolution.

• Identify opportunities to improve usability, merchandising, conversion, and operational efficiency, then bring recommendations to the team.

• Monitor relevant Shopify reporting and storefront performance and help the team understand issues or opportunities that require action.



How Technical Work Is Handled

We are deliberately separating storefront operations from custom development. You are not expected to be a Liquid, CSS, or JavaScript developer. When a requirement falls outside the visual editor or normal app/theme configuration, you should be able to recognize that boundary, define the problem clearly, and coordinate the appropriate outside resource.

• Work with outside Shopify developers or other freelancers when custom code, deeper theme styling, custom sections, advanced performance work, or similar technical work is required.

• Provide the developer with clear requirements and relevant store/theme context.

• Test the completed work, confirm it solves the original need, and make sure it integrates cleanly with the storefront.

• Avoid unapproved code changes or technical shortcuts that create maintenance problems later.



What We Are Looking For

• Demonstrated hands-on experience administering and configuring Shopify stores.

• Experience implementing or substantially configuring Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes. Experience with premium third-party themes is strongly preferred; Ella experience is a plus.

• Strong understanding of products, variants, collections, navigation, templates, sections, blocks, metafields, swatches, merchandising, and storefront settings.

• Experience with apparel, print-on-demand, or complex product variants is strongly preferred. Printful or similar fulfillment-platform experience is useful.

• Comfort working with Shopify apps and understanding how app widgets, forms, and integrations affect the storefront.

• Excellent QA habits and attention to detail, particularly across mobile and desktop experiences.

• Ability to troubleshoot independently, use vendor documentation and support effectively, and know when a problem should be escalated to a developer.

• Good written English and clear communication with a remote team and outside freelancers.

• Organized, dependable, and comfortable owning a system rather than waiting for every individual task to be assigned.

• Good visual and merchandising judgment. You do not need to be the brand designer, but you should understand when a storefront feels inconsistent, cluttered, confusing, or unfinished.



How We Work

Grizzly Mine already has defined brand direction, product strategy, and a documented storefront plan. This role is not being hired to reinvent the brand. You will work from that direction, contribute your Shopify expertise, raise concerns when you see a better way to execute something, and take responsibility for getting approved decisions implemented correctly.

The role will work closely with the founder and the existing remote team. We value people who can take ownership, communicate clearly, document what they change, and move work forward without creating unnecessary complexity.

Initial Success in This Role

• Become familiar with the existing Shopify store, Ella theme, launch blueprint, and configuration guide.

• Help complete the storefront implementation in the planned sequence and maintain a clean record of key configuration decisions.

• Validate the core product experience and integrations before launch.

• Complete launch QA and help resolve issues before the storefront goes live.

• Transition naturally from implementation into ongoing ownership of Shopify storefront operations.

description:

Employment Type: Full-Time



Department: Accounting & Finance





About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Bookkeeper / Accounts Officer to join our team remotely. In this role, you will manage day-to-day bookkeeping, financial reporting, and account administration across a portfolio of business units. This is a great opportunity for a detail-oriented, self-motivated finance professional who enjoys variety and can work independently in a remote setting.





What You will Do



? Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, including accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, and general ledger entries, etc.



? Prepare monthly financial reports and annual financial statements, profit and loss, balance sheet



? Manage the company’s multiple accounts, including cash flow management



? Prepare and lodge BAS/IAS in line with ATO requirements



? Liaise with various government agencies and our tax accountant



? Maintain and update ASIC records when required



? Prepare and organize financial documentation to support tax return preparation and audits (as directed by the accountant/tax agent)



? Maintain accurate, organized financial records and filing systems



? Perform other ad-hoc duties as required whenever have some spare time to help our admin team





What We are Looking For



? 5+ years of experience in a bookkeeping or accounts officer role, ideally with an Australian company or accounting firm



? Minimum Bachelor degree in Accounting; CPA qualification



? Accounting qualification and experience is a must



? Minimum three years working experience in an accounting firm or department is a must



? Strong working knowledge of Australian accounting and BAS/GST requirements



? Good experience working as a bookkeeper or accountant for an Australian company, with strong knowledge of MYOB and Xero



? Strong Excel skills and general comfort with financial systems



? Excellent attention to detail and accuracy, trustworthy and reliable



? Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines



? Comfortable working in a fully remote, self-directed environment with reliable internet access and little distraction from home





What We Offer



? Fully remote work from Mon to Fri 8:30am to 5:30pm AEST Brisbane, Australia time, with a 1-hour break in between



? Opportunities for professional development and training support



? Collaborative, supportive team culture



? One of Queensland's top 40 private companies





How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit a resume outlining relevant bookkeeping/accounts experience. Provide at least 2 contact references from your previous AU clients.

title: Content & SEO Copywriter
description:
About Well Aware:



Well Aware is a fractional operations consulting and virtual assistant staffing company. We help growing businesses reclaim time, improve operations, and build scalable systems through consulting, process improvement, systems implementation, and specialized talent.



We are expanding our marketing and content production capacity and are looking for a Content & SEO Copywriter who can turn research, business information, target keywords, and content briefs into clear, useful, engaging, and search-friendly content.



This role combines recurring client content production with SEO-focused marketing copywriting.



The Copywriter will support content across
 newsletters, blogs, website and service pages, case studies, and other marketing assets. The role is focused primarily on execution and production rather than owning the company's overall SEO or marketing strategy.



The ideal candidate is a strong writer who is comfortable researching unfamiliar industries, writing for different audiences, using AI and SEO tools as part of the production workflow, incorporating feedback, and managing recurring content deadlines.



Role Overview:



The Content & SEO Copywriter will be responsible for researching, writing, editing, optimizing, and preparing content for multiple client and company marketing initiatives.



Content may include:



-
 newsletters

- Blog posts

- Website pages

- Service pages

- VA service pages

- Case studies

- SEO-focused marketing content

- Existing content optimization

- Repurposed content

- LinkedIn and other supporting marketing content



The role requires the ability to move between different industries, audiences, and content formats while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and the appropriate tone for each account.



The Copywriter should understand that effective SEO content is not simply about inserting keywords. Content must satisfy search intent, communicate clearly, provide value to the intended audience, and support the underlying business objective.



Core Responsibilities:



1. Content Research & Planning

- Research assigned industries, companies, topics, and audiences before writing.

- Review client websites, existing content, source materials, and other relevant information.

- Research and propose relevant topics for newsletters, blogs, and other content.

- Understand the purpose, audience, and business objective of each piece of content.

- Participate in content planning sessions when needed.

- Maintain awareness of upcoming content requirements and deadlines.

- Identify opportunities to create multiple content assets from the same research or source material.



The Copywriter should become familiar with the terminology, services, audience, positioning, and content preferences of each account they support.



2.
 Newsletter Writing



- Produce recurring
 newsletter content for assigned client accounts.

- Responsibilities may include:

- Researching newsletter topics.

- Developing newsletter concepts and angles.

- Writing newsletter copy.

- Incorporating client-specific messaging and preferences.

- Editing and proofreading content.

- Incorporating internal and client feedback.

- Preparing approved newsletters for production.

- Formatting newsletters within platforms such as Mailchimp or GoHighLevel (GHL).

- Scheduling approved campaigns when required.

- Maintaining visibility over upcoming newsletter deadlines.



The Copywriter should ensure that newsletters are delivered with sufficient time for review, revision, approval, and scheduling.



3. Blog & SEO Content Writing



Write useful, engaging, and search-friendly blog content based on approved topics, briefs, and SEO inputs.



Responsibilities include:



- Working from target keywords and understanding their search intent.

- Researching assigned topics thoroughly.

- Developing logical content structures.

- Writing clear and useful long-form content.

- Incorporating keywords naturally.

- Using appropriate headings, paragraphs, and supporting sections.

- Optimizing content for readability and search visibility.

- Fact-checking information before publication.

- Revising content based on editorial and client feedback.

- The Copywriter should prioritize usefulness, readability, accuracy, and search intent rather than keyword density.



4. Website & Service Page Copywritingz



Create and improve website and service-related content.



This may include:



- Website pages

- Service pages

- VA service pages

- Landing page copy

- Supporting marketing pages

- Existing website content



Responsibilities include:



- Translating complex services into clear customer-focused language.

- Maintaining consistent terminology and positioning.

- Communicating business value clearly.

- Structuring content for readability and SEO.

- Incorporating relevant target keywords.

- Identifying opportunities to improve existing website copy.

- Ensuring content supports the intended audience and marketing objective.



5. Case Study & Evidence-Based Content



Transform research, interviews, approved source material, and client information into compelling case study content.



Responsibilities include:



- Understanding the client's original challenge.

- Identifying the objectives and business context.

- Documenting the approach taken.

- Clearly communicating relevant services and capabilities.

- Highlighting measurable outcomes where verified.

- Incorporating approved testimonials and proof points.

- Structuring the story around business value rather than simply listing completed tasks.



The Copywriter must never invent results, metrics, client statements, or other unsupported claims.

When information is unclear or insufficiently supported, the Copywriter should identify the information as requiring validation before publication.



6. SEO & Content Optimization



Optimize new and existing content using established SEO and content standards.



Responsibilities include:



- Reviewing target keywords and search intent.

-  Incorporating keywords naturally.

-  Optimizing headings and content structure.

- Reviewing word count and paragraph structure.

- Improving readability and content flow.

- Identifying opportunities to strengthen existing content.

- Using SEO/content optimization tools to evaluate drafts.

- Applying recommendations from the Marketing Operations Manager and SEO support.

- Keeping reasonably current with changes in SEO and content-writing practices.



The Copywriter is not expected to own the company's complete SEO strategy. The primary responsibility is to execute SEO requirements accurately and effectively.



7. Content Repurposing



Adapt approved source content into additional marketing assets when required.



For example:



Research / Source Material → Core Content → Multiple Marketing Assets



This may include repurposing:



- Case studies into LinkedIn content.

- Blog content into newsletters.

- Website content into social posts.

- Client research into multiple content pieces.

- Existing marketing content into supporting sales or promotional materials.



The Copywriter must maintain consistency with the approved source material when repurposing content.



8. Review, Editing & Revisions



- Proofread all content before submission.

- Review grammar, spelling, structure, tone, and factual accuracy.

- Incorporate internal feedback accurately.

- Incorporate client feedback efficiently.

- Track recurring client preferences.

- Apply previously established feedback to future content.

- Minimize unnecessary revisions by reviewing work carefully before submission.

- Maintain consistency across content produced for the same client or brand.



9. Content Production & Workflow Management



The Copywriter will also take ownership of the operational side of recurring content production.



This includes:



- Managing assigned content deadlines.

- Working efficiently through batch production.

- Maintaining visibility over upcoming content.

- Organizing drafts and source materials.

- Following established content workflows.

- Updating content status and production information.

- Identifying bottlenecks or recurring production issues.

- Suggesting improvements to the content workflow.

- Maintaining process documentation when appropriate.



The goal is not simply to produce individual pieces of content, but to help increase the speed, consistency, and capacity of the overall content production pipeline.

title: Calling Auto Repair Shops
description:
Your job: To call automotive repair facilities in the usa starting with San Diego CA and SoCal area and work your way up to Seattle WA and offer them the FareigX program which leads into the Frei Homes program. The following is the opportunity for auto repair shops in the USA:



FAREIGX Master AutoTech Werks & FREI HOMES programs: A MASTER OPERATIONAL FRAMEWORK

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

This document outlines the operational workflows, labor structures, and financial architecture of the FareigX and Frei Homes dual-income joint venture. The enterprise operates as a synchronized ecosystem: high-volume automotive triage clinics function as self-funding customer acquisition engines, capturing leads at zero additional cost to feed a heavily leveraged, high-yield commercial real estate portfolio.

PILLAR I: THE FAREIGX AUTOMOTIVE ENGINE

The 3-Pillar Intake Workflow

The mechanical division abandons traditional passive auto repair models in favor of a highly aggressive, forced-intake pipeline designed to isolate and dominate high-ticket repairs.

1.

The Weekend Triage Clinic: Dedicated strictly to high-volume, low-friction services (free oil changes and Digital Vehicle Inspections using).

2.

The Weekday Repair Pipeline: Reserved exclusively for high-ticket, heavy mechanical repairs identified during the weekend triage.

3.

Database Monetization: Capturing the automotive client pipeline to cross-sell into real estate and property maintenance funnels.

12-Bay Hub Capacity & Staffing

A flagship 12-bay FareigX mechanical hub requires a dedicated local commuter base and operates with distinct weekend and weekday labor structures to maximize bay efficiency.

•

Weekend Triage Labor: Staffed by C-Techs (specialized in performing only free oil changes and free vehicle inspections) and dedicated Service Writers. Their sole directive is processing maximum vehicle volume of oil changes and vehicle inspections on the weekend only.

•

Intake Volume: A fully optimized 12-bay hub executes 825 diagnostic inspections per month.

•

The Conversion Metric: Operating at a 40% conversion rate, the weekend clinic produces 330 high-ticket repair orders into the weekday pipeline.

•

The ARO Multiplier: Vehicle inspections consistently identify $4,000 to $5,000 in necessary repairs and servicing. By taking the conservative benchmark of $4,000 and dividing it by approximately 33%, and working with our finance partners to fund those repairs and maintenance, we secure the target Average Repair Order (ARO) of $1,350. Because low-yield jobs are filtered out over the weekend, master weekday technicians exclusively execute heavy repairs, sustaining this dominant $1,350 ARO.

Equipment & Capital Expenditure Strategy

To offer durability, and be at operational scale, our equipment strategy leverages cost-effective brand partnerships alongside streamlined procurement:

•

Equipment Recommendations: HOFMANN equipment is suggested for its optimal balance of price and overall quality, further backed by the engineering and service trust of Snap-on Corporation and Mulligan Equipment Sales.

•

Multiple Equipment Piece Purchase: We recommend a multi-piece equipment procurement strategy. The monthly cost for this CapEx equipment package is fully offset and covered by the volume of repair revenue generated directly by the vehicle inspection process.

•

Lifting & Diagnostics: Using a HOFMANN wheel alignment machine for (Vehicle Inspections, 2-minute audits) diagnostics and repairs of late modeled vehicles, with new lifts, tire changers, and wheel balancers is offered by Mulligan Equipment Sales.

PILLAR II: THE FREI HOMES REAL ESTATE INTEGRATION

Rather than capping revenue at the mechanical transaction, the massive pipeline generated by the FareigX hubs is diverted into the Frei Homes Program (FHP), transforming automotive clients into real estate acquisitions, residential rental placements, and homeownership funnels.

Property Acquisition & The Conversion Multiplier

Targeting $700,000 median properties (3,000+ square feet) x a multipliers for maxing out of room for rent and then utilizing a traditional DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) hybrid commercial loan, the structural layout is aggressively optimized for maximum yield.

•

Base Layout: Standard 4-5 legal rooms.

•

The Multiplier: By converting garages and underutilized square footage, the property is subjected to a 1.8x room multiplier.

•

Final Yield: 7.2 to 9 fully functional, individual rentable rooms with home ownership per property.

Frei Homes Unit Economics

•

Gross Revenue Target: $2,000 per room monthly = $14,400 gross monthly income per property ($172,800 annually).

•

15% Operational Cost Basis: Operating costs are at 15% (covering utilities, conversion maintenance, and facility upkeep).

•

Zero Management Friction: Third-party property management fees are eliminated ($0) through the proprietary built-in homeownership structure.

•

Debt Service: The remaining revenue aggressively services the commercial DSCR PITI (Principal, Interest, Taxes, Insurance) debt load, yielding an unencumbered net cash flow.



DUAL-INCOME from 1 FareigX & 1 Frei Homes program PRO FORMA ANALYSIS

A single "dual-income unit" consists of 1 FareigX Mechanical Hub paired with 1 localized Frei Homes Property Portfolio.

Annual Pro Forma (Single Dual-Income Unit)



Gross Annual Revenue

Annual Cost Factor + Debt



Net Annual Cash Flow

1 Auto Repair Shop x FareigX Mechanical Hub

$5,346,000 Gross Year

$3,065,196 Gross Profit Year

$2,280,804 Net to Owners a Year



1 Home x Frei Homes Portfolio

$172,800 Gross

$79,920 Pro forma expenses including debt for property

$92,880 Net to Owners per year



TOTAL SINGLE DUAL-INCOME UNIT

$5,518,800 Gross

$3,145,116 Expenses including COGS & Debt Services

$2,373,684 Net to Owners Pocket



Key Operational Summary

By deploying a single synchronized FareigX Hub and Frei Homes property portfolio:

•

Gross Annual Revenue: $5,518,800

•

Annual Operating Expenses & Debt Service: $3,145,116

•

Net Annual Distributable Cash Flow: $2,373,684

title: Property Manager
description:
Virtual Assistant — Property Management





About Us

We are a growing operators owners and property-management business overseeing more than 240 multifamily apartment units in the Greater Boston area. As our portfolio expands, we are building a dependable team to help manage our properties, support our residents, and improve day-to-day operations.

We value accountability, clear communication, sound judgment, and people who take ownership of their responsibilities. This is an opportunity to join a growing company and develop into a larger role over time.







Position Overview

We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with property-management experience and excellent written and spoken English.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who can work independently, exercise good judgment, and take ownership of maintenance and tenant requests. We need someone who can think through scheduling, urgency, cost, and tenant impact—not simply follow instructions.





Responsibilities

Receive, organize, and respond to tenant maintenance requests

Assess the urgency of requests and determine appropriate next steps

Coordinate vendors, maintenance technicians, tenants, and property managers

Schedule repairs and confirm appointments

Obtain, review, and compare estimates when appropriate

Follow up until every issue is completely resolved

Keep tenants informed through clear and professional communication

Research vendors, products, pricing, and possible solutions

Consider cost, quality, scheduling, and operational tradeoffs

Create and update work orders in Buildium

Maintain accurate notes, invoices, records, and task statuses

Escalate emergencies and significant expenses appropriately

Identify recurring property issues and recommend improvements

Assist with leasing, administrative, and property-management tasks as needed





Qualifications

Previous property-management experience is required

Fluent written and spoken English

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

Strong tenant and vendor communication

Ability to prioritize multiple requests and meet deadlines

Comfortable working independently with limited supervision

Strong research, judgment, and problem-solving abilities

Able to evaluate alternatives and recommend practical solutions

Reliable internet connection and professional remote workspace

Experience with Buildium is strongly preferred

Familiarity with Slack, Quo, Notion, and similar tools is helpful

Availability during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time working hours





What Success Looks Like

Tenant requests are acknowledged promptly and professionally

Emergencies are identified and escalated immediately

Routine maintenance is scheduled efficiently

Vendors and tenants receive consistent follow-up

Work orders are tracked through final completion

Decisions reflect a sensible balance of cost, quality, and speed

Property records remain accurate and current

Problems are presented to management with potential solutions

The property-management team can rely on you without constant supervision





To Apply Please submit:

A brief introduction and a quick video introduction

A description of your property-management experience

The property-management software you have used

Your availability and time zone

Your desired hourly rate

An example of a maintenance issue you independently researched, coordinated, and resolved

Your approach to handling several urgent tenant requests at the same time

title: Join Strategy North – Senior Web Designer + Web Developer (Lead Generation)
description:
At Strategy North, we build performance-led funnels for high-ticket B2C (lead gen) and ecomm brands.



Every campaign we run lives or dies on the page it sends traffic to. We're looking for a Senior Web Designer + Developer who can own that layer end to end: designing high-converting pages in Figma, then building them properly in WordPress and GoHighLevel (GHL) without needing to be walked through it.



To be clear, this is not a brand or agency-portfolio design role. Everything you design has a job to do: turn paid traffic into leads, booked calls and sales. Our strategy and media buying drive the traffic. Your work d
 how much of it converts.



**Your Role**



- Design landing pages, funnels and websites in Figma, from wireframe through to polished, dev-ready files with responsive (mobile-first) layouts, components and clear handoff specs.

- Build those designs in WordPress and GHL so they're pixel-accurate, fast, clean and conversion-ready.

- Design and build a range of funnel types: quiz funnels, book-a-call funnels, lead magnet funnels, VSL pages, product and offer pages.

- Turn briefs and copy into page structures that convert, and bring your own ideas on layout, hierarchy, social proof and CTAs.

- Build and maintain reusable Figma libraries and WordPress/GHL templates so new builds ship faster without losing quality.

- Make sure every build is technically sound: forms passing data to the CRM, tracking and pixels in place, integrations working, page speed optimised.

- Iterate quickly on variants for testing (headlines, layouts, offers) and roll out winners across the funnel.

- Keep builds documented, tidy and easy to hand off.



**What We're Looking For**



- 5+ years designing and building websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows both the Figma files and the live builds.

- Expert in Figma: auto layout, components, variants, design systems and clean dev handoff.

- Advanced WordPress development: page builders (Elementor, Bricks or similar), custom themes, plugins, and comfort with HTML, CSS and some JavaScript when a builder isn't enough.

- Advanced GHL experience: funnels, websites, forms, surveys, calendars, and how pages connect to GHL workflows and pipelines.

- A strong eye for direct response design. You understand why a page converts, not just how it looks.

- Solid grasp of page speed, responsive design and on-page tracking basics (Meta pixel, Google tags, conversion events).

- Reliable, detail-obsessed and clear in communication. The kind of person who closes the loop rather than leaving things half-done.

- Bonus: Shopify experience, Google Tag Manager, Zapier or similar automation tools, and CRO/A-B testing experience.



**What You Get**



- Minimum 20 hours per week, with room to grow as you take on more of our design and build work.

- A 2-week paid trial to start, so both sides can make sure it's the right fit.

- Work across growing brands in industries like finance, investing and DTC.

- Be part of a lean, results-driven agency where your pages directly drive client results, and where there's real room to grow.



**To Apply**



Send your portfolio with at least two funnels or landing pages you designed in Figma and built in WordPress or GHL. Include links to the live pages and a line on the result each one drove, if you know it.

title: Legal Assistant/Intake Coordinator
description:
We are seeking an experienced Legal Assistant / Intake Coordinator to support a California law firm with day-to-day legal administration, client intake, case coordination, and attorney support.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with California law firms, is highly comfortable using Clio Manage as a daily case-management system, and has practical experience with court filings through One Legal and U.S. court e-filing systems.



Key Responsibilities

Support attorneys and legal staff with day-to-day administrative and case-related tasks.

Manage and update client and matter information in Clio Manage on a daily basis.

Assist with new client intake, including collecting, organizing, and accurately entering client and case information.

FAREIGX Master AutoTech Werks & FREI HOMES programs: A MASTER OPERATIONAL FRAMEWORK

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

This document outlines the operational workflows, labor structures, and financial architecture of the FareigX and Frei Homes dual-income joint venture. The enterprise operates as a synchronized ecosystem: high-volume automotive triage clinics function as self-funding customer acquisition engines, capturing leads at zero additional cost to feed a heavily leveraged, high-yield commercial real estate portfolio.

PILLAR I: THE FAREIGX AUTOMOTIVE ENGINE

The 3-Pillar Intake Workflow

The mechanical division abandons traditional passive auto repair models in favor of a highly aggressive, forced-intake pipeline designed to isolate and dominate high-ticket repairs.

1.

The Weekend Triage Clinic: Dedicated strictly to high-volume, low-friction services (free oil changes and Digital Vehicle Inspections using).

2.

The Weekday Repair Pipeline: Reserved exclusively for high-ticket, heavy mechanical repairs identified during the weekend triage.

3.

Database Monetization: Capturing the automotive client pipeline to cross-sell into real estate and property maintenance funnels.

12-Bay Hub Capacity & Staffing

A flagship 12-bay FareigX mechanical hub requires a dedicated local commuter base and operates with distinct weekend and weekday labor structures to maximize bay efficiency.

•

Weekend Triage Labor: Staffed by C-Techs (specialized in performing only free oil changes and free vehicle inspections) and dedicated Service Writers. Their sole directive is processing maximum vehicle volume of oil changes and vehicle inspections on the weekend only.

•

Intake Volume: A fully optimized 12-bay hub executes 825 diagnostic inspections per month.

•

The Conversion Metric: Operating at a 40% conversion rate, the weekend clinic produces 330 high-ticket repair orders into the weekday pipeline.

•

The ARO Multiplier: Vehicle inspections consistently identify $4,000 to $5,000 in necessary repairs and servicing. By taking the conservative benchmark of $4,000 and dividing it by approximately 33%, and working with our finance partners to fund those repairs and maintenance, we secure the target Average Repair Order (ARO) of $1,350. Because low-yield jobs are filtered out over the weekend, master weekday technicians exclusively execute heavy repairs, sustaining this dominant $1,350 ARO.

Equipment & Capital Expenditure Strategy

To offer durability, and be at operational scale, our equipment strategy leverages cost-effective brand partnerships alongside streamlined procurement:

•

Equipment Recommendations: HOFMANN equipment is suggested for its optimal balance of price and overall quality, further backed by the engineering and service trust of Snap-on Corporation and Mulligan Equipment Sales.

•

Multiple Equipment Piece Purchase: We recommend a multi-piece equipment procurement strategy. The monthly cost for this CapEx equipment package is fully offset and covered by the volume of repair revenue generated directly by the vehicle inspection process.

•

Lifting & Diagnostics: Using a HOFMANN wheel alignment machine for (Vehicle Inspections, 2-minute audits) diagnostics and repairs of late modeled vehicles, with new lifts, tire changers, and wheel balancers is offered by Mulligan Equipment Sales.

PILLAR II: THE FREI HOMES REAL ESTATE INTEGRATION

Rather than capping revenue at the mechanical transaction, the massive pipeline generated by the FareigX hubs is diverted into the Frei Homes Program (FHP), transforming automotive clients into real estate acquisitions, residential rental placements, and homeownership funnels.

Property Acquisition & The Conversion Multiplier

Targeting $700,000 median properties (3,000+ square feet) x a multipliers for maxing out of room for rent and then utilizing a traditional DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) hybrid commercial loan, the structural layout is aggressively optimized for maximum yield.

•

Base Layout: Standard 4-5 legal rooms.

•

The Multiplier: By converting garages and underutilized square footage, the property is subjected to a 1.8x room multiplier.

•

Final Yield: 7.2 to 9 fully functional, individual rentable rooms with home ownership per property.

Frei Homes Unit Economics

•

Gross Revenue Target: $2,000 per room monthly = $14,400 gross monthly income per property ($172,800 annually).

•

15% Operational Cost Basis: Operating costs are at 15% (covering utilities, conversion maintenance, and facility upkeep).

•

Zero Management Friction: Third-party property management fees are eliminated ($0) through the proprietary built-in homeownership structure.

•

Debt Service: The remaining revenue aggressively services the commercial DSCR PITI (Principal, Interest, Taxes, Insurance) debt load, yielding an unencumbered net cash flow.

title: GoHighLevel Systems Specialist | Workflows, AI Agents & Agency Admin | Full-Time Remote | US Eastern Hours
description:
Be the technical engine behind a growing sales and marketing agency. Legacy Sales Engineering is hiring an experienced GoHighLevel Systems Specialist to own our GHL platform end to end: building custom workflows, deploying AI agents, setting up sub-accounts, and running the agency administration that keeps every client system humming.



This is a full-time, long-term seat for someone who already knows GoHighLevel deeply and wants a stable home to put that skill to work.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Build and maintain custom automation workflows with clean conditional logic: if/then branches, wait steps, goal events, and trigger logic that holds up under real volume.



Deploy and configure GHL AI agents: Conversation AI for multi-channel chat, Voice AI for calls, and Workflow AI actions inside automations. Set personas, knowledge bases, objectives, and escalation rules.



Set up and manage sub-accounts and reusable snapshots so new clients can be launched quickly and consistently.



Handle full agency administration: user and permission management, calendars, pipelines, forms and surveys, funnels, email and SMS setup, reputation and review automation, and integrations.



Connect third-party tools through Make, Zapier, webhooks, and APIs when a native integration does not exist.



Document your builds with clear Loom walkthroughs so any system can be understood and handed off cleanly.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



Proven, hands-on GoHighLevel experience in live agency or multi-client environments. This is not an entry-level role and we will test for it.



A real command of the workflow builder, sub-account and snapshot architecture, and the current GHL AI stack.



Experience with integrations: Make or Zapier, webhooks, and basic API concepts.



The ability to translate a business process into a reliable automation without a step-by-step spec.



Strong written and spoken English, since you will document systems and communicate with our team directly.



A GoHighLevel certification is a strong plus. Real proven builds matter more, and you will show them.



THE SCHEDULE AND SETUP



This is a full-time, 40 hour per week salaried position, Monday through Friday, working US Eastern time hours. You will need a reliable computer, strong high-speed internet, and reliable power.



COMPENSATION



Salaried at 200 US dollars per week for full-time, 40 hours per week. Paid weekly. This is a stable, long-term role with room to grow as the agency grows.



HOW WE HIRE



After a short screening chat, every serious candidate completes a paid hands-on skills test: you will build a real workflow and an AI agent in a GHL sub-account and walk us through it on a Loom. It takes about two hours and it is the fastest way for a real specialist to stand out from the crowd.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short note telling us your GoHighLevel experience, a link to any portfolio, case studies, or Loom walkthroughs of systems you have built, and where you saw this post listed. Tell us about the most complex GHL automation you have personally built. We respond to every serious applicant.

title: Evolving Executive Operations Support to Founders
description:
Evolving Executive Operations Coordinator to the Founders



Executive Assistant – Operations & Strategy



Supporting the Founders of Growing Healthcare Companies



**Remote | 30–40 hours/week | Primarily 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time**

**Starting Rate: $3.50/hour with opportunity for growth based on performance, trust, responsibility and company growth**



We Are Looking for More Than a Traditional VA



We are looking for a highly organized, trustworthy and strategic Executive Assistant who can become a trusted right hand to our CEO and CFO.



You will support the Founders across three growing healthcare organizations:



* A Kind Heart Healthcare Services (AKH)

* H.E.A.R.T. Global Ops (HGO)

* AHeart IV & Wellness



This is **not a passive assistant role**.



We need someone who thinks ahead, identifies what may be falling through the cracks, researches before escalating, brings possible solutions, follows through and helps turn ideas into organized execution.



Our Mission & Vision



Our mission is to build and support heart-led healthcare organizations that serve people with compassion while operating with integrity, accountability and excellence.



Our vision is to responsibly grow our impact across multiple communities and states without losing the heart, relationships and purpose behind why we started.



Our core values are **H.E.A.R.T.: Holistic Thinking, Empowerment, Accountability, Relationships and Trust.**



Skills can be developed. **Character, integrity and trustworthiness are essential.**



What You Will Do



You will help the CEO and CFO stay organized, prepared and several steps ahead.



Key responsibilities include:



* Manage executive calendars,
s, priorities and follow-ups

* Maintain executive to-do, “waiting for” and decision lists

* Turn meetings,
s and ideas into clear actions, owners and deadlines

* Prepare concise daily/weekly executive briefs

* Research business opportunities, markets, state expansion and strategic projects

* Compare information and present organized recommendations—not just links

* Coordinate communication and follow-up with leaders and team members

* Create and improve SOPs, trackers and workflows

* Research and coordinate business travel, conferences and meetings

* Support 
, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and other business systems

* Track projects, deadlines, risks and incomplete commitments

* Assist with special projects for AKH, HGO and AHeart

* Help the Founders protect their time for strategy, relationships, growth and major decisions



Who We Are Looking For



You may be an excellent fit if you:



* Naturally think several steps ahead

* Are highly organized and detail-oriented

* Follow through without repeated reminders

* Can respectfully hold leaders accountable

* Enjoy research and turning complicated information into clear recommendations

* Bring solutions instead of only identifying problems

* Have strong written and spoken English

* Can manage multiple priorities without losing important details

* Know when to solve something independently and when to escalate

* Are resourceful and comfortable learning new technology

* Can be trusted with highly confidential business and executive information

* Want a long-term opportunity rather than simply another VA job

* Are excited to help build systems in growing companies



Executive assistant, operations, project management, SOP, healthcare, 
, Microsoft 365, research and executive-support experience are highly preferred.



Confidentiality & Trust



This role may eventually have access to executive communications, financial information, company strategies, agreements, employee information and other sensitive materials.



Confidentiality is **nonnegotiable**. Access will be provided gradually as trust and performance are demonstrated.



Growth Opportunity



We are building for the long term.



For an exceptional person who earns trust, delivers results and grows with the organization, this role may eventually develop into greater executive operations, project management or Chief-of-Staff-type responsibilities.



We do not promise automatic promotions or raises. Growth is based on **performance, trust, increased responsibility and company growth.**



How to Apply



Please do NOT send only the standard OnlineJobs.ph application.



 your application directly to:







Subject: Executive Assistant – Operations & Strategy – [Your Full Name]



Please include:



1. Your résumé

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Why our mission and this opportunity interest you

4. Your available start date and desired weekly hours

5. Your current job, clients, school or other recurring commitments

6. Your experience supporting executives, operations or strategic projects

7. One example of a problem you solved without waiting to be told exactly what to do

8. One example of anticipating what a leader needed before they asked

9. Your experience with
/calendar management, research, SOPs, 
, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace or similar systems



Most Important Question



In 250 words or less, answer:



If you became the CEO and CFO’s trusted right hand, what would you focus on during your first 90 days to help our companies become more organized, accountable and prepared for responsible growth?”**



Please write your answer yourself. We want to understand how you think, communicate and solve problems.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a practical skills assessment.



We are not looking for perfection. We are looking for character, heart, initiative, sound judgment, organization, accountability and genuine alignment with our mission.



Building with Heart. Leading with Purpose. Growing Through Service.

title: Podcast video editor
description:
Role Overview

You will own end-to-end video post-production for a weekly interview podcast. You will take raw multi-track

recordings and deliver a polished long-form episode, a podcast-ready audio file, and a set of vertical short-form

clips.

This is a role for an editor who works fluently with AI-assisted tools but brings real editorial judgment about pacing,

cuts, and what makes a moment land. The client is early in the show's life and actively developing their visual style,

so the first several episodes involve close collaboration and iteration. Your taste will shape the direction of the

show.



Responsibilities

Long-Form Editing

• Edit raw multi-track recordings into a polished episode, typically 30 minutes in length

• Build a clean side-by-side or multi-angle layout from separate host and guest video and audio tracks

• Remove filler, dead air, false starts, and tangents while preserving natural conversational flow

• Apply color correction and visual smoothing for a consistent look across episodes



Audio Production

• Perform audio cleanup, levelling, and noise reduction across separate speaker tracks

• Handle variable guest audio quality, since guests record remotely on their own equipment

• Deliver a podcast-ready audio file suitable for distribution



Short-Form Editing

• Cut 3 to 5 vertical clips per episode for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok

• Select moments with genuine standalone hook value rather than arbitrary segments

• Add clean, accurate captions and simple text treatments consistent with brand style



Collaboration and Workflow

• Work from a shared Riverside and Google Drive folder structure with clear stage gates

• Receive batched revision notes through 
 and turn them around cleanly in a single pass

• Stay reachable on the client's team channel for quick questions

• Help build and maintain a style and preferences document as feedback patterns emerge across the first month



Tools

• Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve for primary editing

• AI-assisted clipping and transcription tools, used with editorial oversight

• Riverside for source recordings and transcripts

• 
 for review and feedback

• Google Drive and Google Workspace



Required Skills

• Two or more years editing long-form interview or talking-head video content

• Demonstrated short-form vertical editing with a clear sense of what holds attention

• Strong audio editing skills, particularly recovering usable audio from imperfect remote recordings

• Fluency with AI-assisted editing tools, paired with the judgment to recognize and override weak automated

output

• Reliable, organized file management and consistent turnaround against a batch workflow

• Strong written and spoken English for direct collaboration with the client team

• Comfortable receiving detailed creative feedback during an iterative early phase



Nice to Have

• Motion graphics and animated caption or transition work

• Thumbnail and still graphic design

• YouTube publishing, metadata, and SEO familiarity

• Multi-camera in-person production experience

• Background in e-commerce, creator economy, or B2B software content

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
Job Type: Full time || Remote



About us

We are a growing team of under 100 people moving fast, wear a few hats, and care about getting the details right. 



The role

We're looking for an Executive Assistant to be the right hand of our Founder and a steady point of contact for the leadership team. At a company our size, this isn't a role where you only manage a calendar. You'll keep the week running, spot problems before they land on anyone's desk, and pick up projects that don't neatly belong to one department.

If you like being trusted with a lot, can switch between big-picture and small details in the same hour, and enjoy making busy people more effective, this role is for you.



What you'll do



Executive support

• Own the Founder's calendar: schedule meetings, protect focus time, and juggle priorities when things change last minute

• Manage the inbox, flag what needs attention, and draft replies on their behalf

• Prepare briefs, agendas and background notes so they walk into every meeting ready

• Book and organise travel, itineraries and expense reports

Leadership and team operations

• Coordinate leadership meetings: set agendas, take notes, and follow up on action items until they're done

• Keep track of key deadlines and commitments across the business

• Act as a go-between for the leadership team, staff, clients and partners

Office and people support

• Help with onboarding new hires, team events and company all-hands

• Look after vendors, subscriptions and office needs [if applicable]

• Keep files, documents and internal tools organised and easy to find

Special projects

• Take on ad-hoc projects such as research, process improvements, reports and presentations

• Spot recurring tasks that could be simplified or automated, and help fix them



What we're looking for

Must-haves

• 5+years as an Executive Assistant directly supporting C-suite executives (CEO, COO, CFO, Founder or equivalent), ideally supporting more than one at the same time

• A track record of managing a senior executive's full calendar, inbox and travel across time zones, including complex, frequently changing schedules

• Experience preparing board meeting materials, investor or leadership updates, and executive briefing packs

• Proven discretion with highly confidential information: financials, compensation, legal matters, fundraising or M&A discussions

• Comfortable acting as the executive's representative with board members, investors, key clients and senior partners

• Strong written English: you can draft
s and documents in the executive's voice that go out with little or no editing

• Sound judgement to d
 what needs the executive's attention and what you can handle yourself

• Confident with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, plus tools like Zoom, Slack and project management software

Nice-to-haves

• Experience in a fast-growing or small company (under 200 people) where the EA role also covers operations

• Background supporting executives through fundraising, an acquisition or rapid scaling

• Familiarity with CRM, expense or HR platforms

• A degree in business administration or a related field, or equivalent experience

When you apply, please tell us which executives you've supported (title and company size) and what a typical week looked like.



What we offer

• Direct exposure to how the business is run, working side by side with leadership

• A small team where your work is visible and your ideas get heard

• Competitive salary based on experience

title: Streamer Content Scout & Social Media Engager
description:
Streamer Content Scout + Social Media Engager



Company: Culture Pulse Media

Pay: $4 USD/hour

Start: Immediately

Position: Part-time with long-term opportunity



Culture Pulse Media is looking for an internet-native Content Scout + Social Media Engager to help grow our entertainment media brands.



We work with content involving streamers, influencers, internet personalities, podcasts, entertainment, and online culture.



This is NOT a traditional social media manager position.



The Role



Your job has two main parts:



1. Content Scouting & Source Finding



You will monitor creators and the surrounding internet ecosystem to find funny, crazy, interesting, controversial, or highly shareable moments that could become short-form content.



Finding a viral clip is only part of the job.



If you discover a Reel, TikTok, Short, or repost, you may need to trace it back to the ORIGINAL long-form source.



For example:



Viral Reel → identify creator/event → find original YouTube video, livestream/VOD, or podcast → locate the exact moment → provide source URL + timestamp



We do not want to simply download another clipper's finished edit.



You need to be resourceful and very good at finding things on the internet.



2. Social Media Engagement



You will help grow our brands by participating naturally in the communities surrounding them.



This includes:



Leaving funny, relevant comments on posts in our niche

Responding to comments on our own content

Finding creators, fan pages, and communities relevant to our brands

Following conversations and trends within the ecosystem

Helping our accounts sound like real members of the community



No bots. No spam. No generic copy-and-paste comments.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



Genuinely follows streamers, influencers, and internet culture

Spends significant time on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other social platforms

Has a strong eye for entertaining and shareable moments

Understands humor, personality, conflict, reactions, and internet culture

Is excellent at online research and source finding

Can distinguish original content from reposts and other clippers' edits

Can write natural, funny, culturally appropriate comments

Is curious and resourceful

Can work independently and figure things out without needing constant direction



You do not need years of professional social media experience.



We care more about your taste, internet knowledge, research ability, resourcefulness, and understanding of online culture.



Job Requirements



You must:



Have strong English proficiency, including understanding casual conversation, slang, humor, and fast-paced dialogue

Be able to write and communicate naturally in English

Have a reliable working computer

Have a fast and stable internet connection

Be comfortable researching across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Kick, Twitch, X, Reddit, and Google

Be reliable and responsive during agreed working hours

Be comfortable occasionally joining video calls in English

Be able to work independently and solve problems

What Success Looks Like



We don't just want someone who sends us a list of trending videos.



We want someone who can say:



“I found this moment, here's why I think it's worth covering, here's the original source, and here's exactly where it happens.”



And on the engagement side, we want someone who understands the culture well enough to participate naturally rather than sounding like a company trying to manufacture engagement.



Apply



Complete the application here:







Do not send a DM. Those inquiries will be ignored.

title: Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist (Full Time, Q4 and Beyond)
description:
About Fitmo



Fitmo is a fast growing DTC wellness brand selling mainly in the US through our Shopify store. Our best seller is Tetra, a smart bracelet for women that looks like fine jewelry: no screen, no notifications, and it tracks heart rate, sleep, stress and blood pressure trends day and night, with a free app and no subscription. Our customers are mostly women 45 and over. We ship hundreds of orders every week and our
 list grows every day through our website popup.



Why we are hiring now



Q4 is here: Black Friday, Cyber Monday and the holidays. We want one dedicated person who owns our
 marketing on Klaviyo, gets our account in top shape for Q4, sends strong campaigns through the season, and then keeps growing
 revenue all year long. This is a long term role, not a one month gig.



What you will do



• Audit our Klaviyo account and keep it healthy: lists, segments, suppressions, sunset policy, sender reputation, domain authentication.

• Own deliverability: keep us out of spam, monitor bounce, complaint and unsubscribe rates, warm up sending volume safely for Q4.

• Restructure the account where needed and tell us what to fix first.

• Build and improve our flows: welcome series, abandoned cart and checkout, browse abandonment, post purchase, win back.

• Plan and build a full Q4 campaign calendar, then keep sending campaigns all year, adapted to each product and launch.

• Design visual, on brand
s (Klaviyo editor, Figma or Canva) and write clear, persuasive copy in natural US English.

• Improve our popup and signup forms to grow the list.

• Read the data every week: open rate, click rate, conversion, revenue per recipient, flow vs campaign revenue. Run A/B tests and report what you learned.

• Bring ideas. We want someone who proposes, not only someone who executes.



What we are looking for



• Proven hands on Klaviyo experience with Shopify brands (2+ years preferred).

• Strong knowledge of deliverability, segmentation and Klaviyo settings.

• Good eye for design and the ability to build
s that look premium.

• Excellent written English.

• Comfortable with data: you know which numbers matter and why.

• Reliable, organized, and able to work independently, with daily check ins with the founder.

• Bonus: experience with health, wellness, jewelry or women's brands, or with SMS.



What we offer



• Full time remote position, $500 to $600 per month based on experience.

• Long term role with a growing brand, working directly with the founder.

• Real ownership of a channel that matters to the business.



How to apply



To show us you read the whole post, start your application with the word TETRA. Applications without it will not be read.



Please answer these questions:

1. How many years have you worked with Klaviyo, and for which brands or agencies?

2. Share 2 or 3 examples of
s, campaigns or flows you built (links or screenshots).

3. What results did you get? (open rate, click rate, revenue from flows, anything you are proud of)

4. Tell us about one deliverability problem you fixed and how you fixed it.

5. Which design tools do you use for
s?

6. Are you currently working for another brand or employer? How many hours per day can you give us?

7. If you joined us tomorrow, what would you do in your first two weeks on our account?

8. What monthly salary do you expect?

title: Calling Auto Repair Shops
description:
Your job: To call automotive repair facilities in the usa starting with San Diego CA and SoCal area and work your way up to Seattle WA and offer them the FareigX program which leads into the Frei Homes program. The following is the opportunity for auto repair shops in the USA:



FAREIGX Master AutoTech Werks & FREI HOMES programs: A MASTER OPERATIONAL FRAMEWORK

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

This document outlines the operational workflows, labor structures, and financial architecture of the FareigX and Frei Homes dual-income joint venture. The enterprise operates as a synchronized ecosystem: high-volume automotive triage clinics function as self-funding customer acquisition engines, capturing leads at zero additional cost to feed a heavily leveraged, high-yield commercial real estate portfolio.



PILLAR I: THE FAREIGX AUTOMOTIVE ENGINE

The 3-Pillar Intake Workflow

The mechanical division abandons traditional passive auto repair models in favor of a highly aggressive, forced-intake pipeline designed to isolate and dominate high-ticket repairs.

1.

The Weekend Triage Clinic: Dedicated strictly to high-volume, low-friction services (free oil changes and Digital Vehicle Inspections using).

2.

The Weekday Repair Pipeline: Reserved exclusively for high-ticket, heavy mechanical repairs identified during the weekend triage.

3.

Database Monetization: Capturing the automotive client pipeline to cross-sell into real estate and property maintenance funnels.



12-Bay Hub Capacity & Staffing

A flagship 12-bay FareigX mechanical hub requires a dedicated local commuter base and operates with distinct weekend and weekday labor structures to maximize bay efficiency.

•

Weekend Triage Labor: Staffed by C-Techs (specialized in performing only free oil changes and free vehicle inspections) and dedicated Service Writers. Their sole directive is processing maximum vehicle volume of oil changes and vehicle inspections on the weekend only.

•

Intake Volume: A fully optimized 12-bay hub executes 825 diagnostic inspections per month.

•

The Conversion Metric: Operating at a 40% conversion rate, the weekend clinic produces 330 high-ticket repair orders into the weekday pipeline.

•

The ARO Multiplier: Vehicle inspections consistently identify $4,000 to $5,000 in necessary repairs and servicing. By taking the conservative benchmark of $4,000 and dividing it by approximately 33%, and working with our finance partners to fund those repairs and maintenance, we secure the target Average Repair Order (ARO) of $1,350. Because low-yield jobs are filtered out over the weekend, master weekday technicians exclusively execute heavy repairs, sustaining this dominant $1,350 ARO.

Equipment & Capital Expenditure Strategy



To offer durability, and be at operational scale, our equipment strategy leverages cost-effective brand partnerships alongside streamlined procurement:

•

Equipment Recommendations: HOFMANN equipment is suggested for its optimal balance of price and overall quality, further backed by the engineering and service trust of Snap-on Corporation and Mulligan Equipment Sales.

•

Multiple Equipment Piece Purchase: We recommend a multi-piece equipment procurement strategy. The monthly cost for this CapEx equipment package is fully offset and covered by the volume of repair revenue generated directly by the vehicle inspection process.

•

Lifting & Diagnostics: Using a HOFMANN wheel alignment machine for (Vehicle Inspections, 2-minute audits) diagnostics and repairs of late modeled vehicles, with new lifts, tire changers, and wheel balancers is offered by Mulligan Equipment Sales.



PILLAR II: THE FREI HOMES REAL ESTATE INTEGRATION

Rather than capping revenue at the mechanical transaction, the massive pipeline generated by the FareigX hubs is diverted into the Frei Homes Program (FHP), transforming automotive clients into real estate acquisitions, residential rental placements, and homeownership funnels.

Property Acquisition & The Conversion Multiplier



Targeting $700,000 median properties (3,000+ square feet) x a multipliers for maxing out of room for rent and then utilizing a traditional DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) hybrid commercial loan, the structural layout is aggressively optimized for maximum yield.

•

Base Layout: Standard 4-5 legal rooms.

•

The Multiplier: By converting garages and underutilized square footage, the property is subjected to a 1.8x room multiplier.

•

Final Yield: 7.2 to 9 fully functional, individual rentable rooms with home ownership per property.

Frei Homes Unit Economics

•

Gross Revenue Target: $2,000 per room monthly = $14,400 gross monthly income per property ($172,800 annually).

•

15% Operational Cost Basis: Operating costs are at 15% (covering utilities, conversion maintenance, and facility upkeep).

•

Zero Management Friction: Third-party property management fees are eliminated ($0) through the proprietary built-in homeownership structure.

•

Debt Service: The remaining revenue aggressively services the commercial DSCR PITI (Principal, Interest, Taxes, Insurance) debt load, yielding an unencumbered net cash flow.



DUAL-INCOME from 1 FareigX & 1 Frei Homes program PRO FORMA ANALYSIS

A single "dual-income unit" consists of 1 FareigX Mechanical Hub paired with 1 localized Frei Homes Property Portfolio.

Annual Pro Forma (Single Dual-Income Unit)



Gross Annual Revenue

Annual Cost Factor + Debt



Net Annual Cash Flow

1 Auto Repair Shop x FareigX Mechanical Hub

$5,346,000 Gross  Income Year

$2,280,804 Net to Owners a Year

TOTAL SINGLE DUAL-INCOME UNIT

Key Operational Summary

By deploying a single synchronized FareigX Hub and Frei Homes property portfolio:

•

Gross Annual Revenue: $5,518,800

•

Annual Operating Expenses & Debt Service: $3,145,116

•

Net Annual Distributable Cash Flow: $2,373,684

title: Part-Time Virtual Medical Assistant (VMA)
description:
Clinical Chart Review & Preparation – Internal Medicine / Family Medicine

Position: Part-Time Virtual Medical Assistant

Work Location: Remote

Schedule: Part-Time / Flexible

Focus: Primary Care Chart Preparation, Preventive Care, MAT, Care Gaps & Clinical Chart Review

Position Summary

We are seeking a medically trained Virtual Medical Assistant (VMA) with strong experience in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Primary Care, or a closely related adult medical specialty.

This is not a basic administrative or data-entry position. The VMA will perform detailed clinical chart preparation and medical record review to help our providers walk into each patient encounter with a clear understanding of the patient's history, current problems, preventive needs, care gaps, medications, laboratory results, and outstanding clinical issues.

The ideal candidate understands longitudinal primary care and can review a medical record with a clinical mindset—identifying information that should be brought to the provider's attention without independently diagnosing, treating, or making clinical decisions.

Primary Responsibilities

Follow-Up Visit Chart Preparation

Review charts before routine and complex follow-up visits and prepare a concise clinical summary for the treating provider.

Review should include:

• Active and historical diagnoses

• Previous assessment and plan

• Recent specialist visits and recommendations

• Current medications and medication changes

• Relevant laboratory and diagnostic results

• Outstanding labs, imaging, referrals, or orders

• Chronic disease monitoring needs

• Preventive services and care gaps

• Items from previous visits that require follow-up

• Potential discrepancies or missing documentation requiring provider review

Annual Wellness Visit Preparation

Perform comprehensive pre-visit chart preparation for Medicare Annual Wellness Visits and other preventive visits.

Preparation may include:

• Review of prior AWV/preventive visit date

• Preventive screening history

• Immunization history

• Cancer screening status

• Fall-risk and functional-assessment needs

• Advance care planning status

• Medication reconciliation

• Appropriate chronic disease monitoring

• Identification of open preventive and quality-measure gaps

• Preparation of information needed for the provider to efficiently complete the visit

Care Gap Review & Closure Preparation

Review patient charts for outstanding care gaps and identify opportunities for appropriate closure.

Examples include:

• Mammography

• Colorectal cancer screening

• Cervical cancer screening

• Diabetic eye examinations

• Diabetic kidney health evaluation

• A1c monitoring

• Blood pressure follow-up

• Vaccinations

• Osteoporosis screening

• Other payer, preventive, or quality-measure requirements

The VMA will determine whether documentation already exists in the chart, whether outside records may need to be obtained, or whether the gap should be brought to the provider's attention.

MAT Chart Review

Prepare charts for patients receiving Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT), including patients receiving buprenorphine products and long-acting injectable therapies.

Review may include:

• Current MAT medication and dose

• Previous treatment plan

• Prescription history documented in the medical record

• Relevant drug-screen results

• Appropriate laboratory monitoring

• Injection history when applicable

• Upcoming or overdue injections

• Medication adherence information documented in the chart

• Relevant behavioral health or recovery information

• Outstanding clinical or documentation items requiring provider attention

Comprehensive Medical Record Review

In addition to visit-specific chart preparation, the VMA will perform broader medical reviews of patient charts to help identify clinical information that may have been missed, overlooked, or not appropriately followed up.

This may include identifying:

• Abnormal laboratory results requiring provider review

• Imaging or diagnostic studies without documented follow-up

• Specialist recommendations that have not been addressed

• Referrals without documented completion

• Chronic conditions without recent monitoring

• Medication discrepancies

• Preventive services that appear overdue

• Incomplete follow-up plans

• Documentation inconsistencies

• Important historical diagnoses or findings that may affect current care

The VMA's responsibility is to identify and flag potential issues for the licensed treating provider, not independently diagnose patients, establish treatment plans, prescribe medications, or make final clinical decisions.

Required Medical Background

This position requires a strong clinical medical background.

Preferred backgrounds include:

• Internal Medicine

• Family Medicine

• General Medicine

• Adult Primary Care

• Geriatric Medicine

• Hospital Medicine or another broad adult medical specialty with substantial experience managing chronic disease

Candidates should be comfortable reviewing patients with multiple chronic medical conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, cardiovascular disease, COPD, obesity, hyperlipidemia, and other common primary-care conditions.

Applicants Who Are Not a Good Fit

Because this position requires broad adult primary-care chart review, applicants whose experience is primarily limited to highly specialized fields generally will not be considered.

This includes applicants whose primary training or experience is in:

• Pathology

• Radiology

• Psychiatry

• Pediatrics

• Other specialties without substantial adult Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or longitudinal primary-care experience

Qualifications

Candidates should have:

• Formal medical or clinical training

• Strong knowledge of Internal Medicine and/or Family Medicine

• Experience reviewing complex adult medical records

• Understanding of common chronic diseases and their routine monitoring

• Ability to interpret the significance of common laboratory and diagnostic results sufficiently to flag them for provider review

• Familiarity with preventive medicine and age-appropriate screenings

• Excellent attention to detail

• Strong written English communication skills

• Ability to create concise, clinically useful chart summaries

• Experience working in an EHR

• Ability to maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality

Experience with Medicare Annual Wellness Visits, care-gap closure, value-based care, chronic care management, or MAT is highly desirable.

What We Are Looking For

We want someone who approaches a chart like a clinician, not simply like a data-entry specialist.

The successful candidate should be able to review a complex patient record and ask:

What does the provider need to know before seeing this patient? What has changed? What needs follow-up? What preventive or chronic-care needs are outstanding? Is there something in this chart that could easily be overlooked?

The goal of this position is to make every patient encounter more organized, comprehensive, efficient, and clinically informed while leaving diagnosis and treatment decisions with the patient's licensed healthcare provider.
