We are a growing Australian retail and e-commerce business looking for an experienced Claims, Returns & Recoveries Specialist to take ownership of customer claims, damaged goods, returns, warranties and recoveries from couriers and suppliers.

This is not a general customer service role.

We are specifically looking for someone with previous hands-on experience managing claims, returns, warranties, damaged goods, courier/freight claims, insurance claims or similar cases.



The Role

You will own claims from opening through to final resolution and financial recovery.

You will investigate what happened, gather evidence, communicate with customers, lodge claims with couriers and suppliers, follow up outstanding recoveries and ensure every case continues moving until it is genuinely resolved.



Responsibilities

- Assess new claims, returns, damaged goods and warranty cases.

- Review customer explanations and identify missing or conflicting information.

- Check orders, tracking, proof of delivery, photos, previous correspondence and other evidence.

- Gather and organise supporting documentation.

- Request additional evidence or information where required.

- Determine the appropriate next action based on the evidence and company policies.

- Communicate professionally with customers throughout the process.

- Lodge and manage courier and freight claims.

- Lodge and manage supplier or manufacturer claims.

- Follow up couriers and suppliers until outstanding claims are resolved.

- Coordinate approved replacements, returns, credits and refunds.

- Maintain accurate claim records, statuses and follow-up dates.

- Track outstanding claim values and amounts recovered.

- Assist with evidence for chargebacks where required.

- Escalate unusual, disputed or high-value cases appropriately.

- Identify recurring causes of claims and report patterns to management.

- Ensure no claim sits without action or misses a deadline.

- Keep cases open until both the customer outcome and any required financial recovery are complete.



What We're Looking For

Essential

- Previous hands-on claims, returns, warranty or dispute-management experience.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Excellent organisation and follow-up.

- Strong judgement and attention to detail.

- Comfortable assessing incomplete or conflicting information.

- Able to make reasonable decisions rather than escalating every issue.

- Able to manage multiple claims at different stages simultaneously.

- Professional and calm when dealing with unhappy customers.

- Strong evidence and documentation skills.

- Able to work independently and take ownership.

- Reliable and available during Sydney business hours.



Highly Regarded

Experience with any of the following:

- Courier or freight claims

- Damaged-goods claims

- E-commerce returns

- Product warranties

- Insurance claims

- Supplier/manufacturer recoveries

- Shopify

- Gorgias or another helpdesk/CRM

- Chargeback evidence

- Furniture, appliances, building products or bulky-item deliveries



What Success Looks Like

If you own a claim, management should not need to remind you to follow it up.

At any point, you should know:

What happened → what's missing → what happens next → who owes a response → when to follow up → how much is outstanding → when the case can be closed.

Your performance will be assessed on areas including:

KPI Expectation

Claims responded to on time High compliance

Complete and accurate evidence High

Follow-ups completed by due date 100% target

Missed claim deadlines 0

Claims sitting without action 0

Average resolution time Continually improve

Courier/supplier recoveries Track value and recovery rate

Outstanding claim value Actively managed

Ageing of unresolved claims Minimise

Case records Accurate and current

Customer communication Clear and professional

Unnecessary management escalation Low



Working Hours

Monday–Friday: 9:00am–5:00pm Sydney time

Saturday: 10:00am–4:00pm Sydney time (optional)

Monday–Friday Sydney hours are required. Saturday availability is preferred but not required.



How to Apply

Please keep your application short and specific.

Include:

1. Your previous experience managing claims, returns, warranties or similar cases.

2. Approximately how many active cases you managed at one time.

3. The systems and tools you used.

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

5. Your earliest available start date.

6. Whether you are available on Saturdays.



Important

We are interested in your actual experience and judgement.

You may use AI tools such as ChatGPT to assist with spelling, grammar or formatting, but your answers must reflect real work you personally performed.

Please do not submit generic, hypothetical or AI-generated examples that do not reflect your own experience. Short, specific answers are preferred.

We may ask you to discuss the details of your example during an interview.

Required Application Question

Tell us about one real claim you personally managed from start to finish.

Briefly explain:

- What happened?

- What did you check first?

- What evidence did you collect?

- Who did you contact?

- How did you follow it up?

- What was the final outcome?

- Was any money recovered? If so, approximately how much?

- At what point did you consider the case closed?

Please use a real example from your own work experience, not a hypothetical scenario.

title: Roblox Developer — Ocean Diving Simulator (Deep Tides)
description:
Deep Tides is a new Roblox ocean diving simulator with PvP currently in pre-development. Players dive into the ocean discovering rare treasures, creatures, and shipwrecks. The deeper they dive the rarer and more dangerous the discoveries. Other players can intercept and steal your loot on the way back up creating high tension PvP moments.



We are looking for an experienced Roblox developer to build this game from scratch to a polished standard.



Before applying please jump on Roblox and play these games so you understand the quality and style we expect — Steal an Egg, Catch and Tame, and Grow a Garden.



You must be confident with Lua scripting, DataStore2, PathfindingService for creature AI, MarketplaceService integration, and cross platform input for PC, Mobile, and Console from day one.



A working demo is required before Milestone 1 is paid. Payment is made via Wise in milestones. You will communicate via WhatsApp and be tracked on Trello.



To apply send the following:



Portfolio or links to Roblox games you have built

Your WhatsApp number

Your Wise

A short message about your experience

Confirm you can reply with "Deep Tides Ready" once you have read the full brief



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Dental CAD Designer (exocad or 3Shape)
description:
We are a small digital dental laboratory near Toronto, Canada. We make fixed restorations only: crowns, bridges, implant crowns and abutments, inlays, onlays and veneers. No dentures, no aligners.



The lab is run by a master technician with 28 years of experience who currently designs every case himself. We are looking for one designer to work with him directly, long term, as our volume grows. This is not an agency role. You would work with the person who checks your work and mills it, and you would hear back on every case.



What you would do

- Design crowns, bridges, implant crowns, custom abutments, inlays, onlays and veneers in (exocad / 3Shape) from intraoral and desktop scans we send you

- Mark margins, set contacts and occlusion, follow the prescription and any notes from the technician

- Design printed models when needed

- Return finished STL files (and the design project file) by the next Toronto morning for cases sent the previous evening

- Make small revisions when asked, usually the same day



What we need from you

- At least 2 years designing fixed restorations in exocad / 3Shape for a real lab (not only training)

- You understand dental anatomy and can design a posterior crown that a technician does not need to rebuild: correct margins, proper contacts, natural occlusal anatomy, good emergence profile

- Experience with implant work (screw-retained crowns, custom abutments) is a strong plus

- Your own licensed software and a computer that runs it. Tell us if you have a dongle or a subscription

- Reliable internet, and you can be reached on 
 or
 during your working hours

- Clear written English



How it works

- Paid per unit, not per hour. Rates set per restoration type (single crown, bridge unit, implant unit). Revisions caused by design errors are included; revisions caused by a change in the prescription are paid

- Starting volume is around [30–60] units per month, growing. We want one person who grows with us, not a rotation of freelancers

- Payment twice a month by Wise or PayPal

- Patient information is confidential. We send case numbers only, and you agree not to share files



How to apply

Send us:

1. Three screenshots of designs you made yourself (a posterior crown, an anterior, and a bridge or implant case)

2. Which software and version you use, and whether you own the licence

3. One or two sentences on how you set the margin line and check contacts

4. Your per-unit rate for a single posterior crown



Shortlisted designers will do a paid test of five real cases before we d
.



We read every application that includes the screenshots. Applications without them will not be answered.

title: People & Culture Operations Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: People & Culture Operations Specialist

100% Remote | Full-Time



We are seeking a detail-focused and highly dependable People & Culture Operations Specialist to help manage the operational side of our global HR function.



Working closely with the Head of People & Culture, you will help ensure that employee records, HR systems, payroll-related updates, recruitment coordination, training requirements, leave administration, and other People & Culture activities are handled accurately and on time.



This position is well suited to someone who is comfortable taking ownership of administrative processes, coordinating with employees and managers across different countries and time zones, keeping track of multiple deadlines, and following tasks through to completion.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:



Employee & HR Operations

-Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Head of People & Culture.

-Manage administrative activities throughout the employee journey, from hiring to separation.

-Prepare employment-related documents, including offer letters, promotion letters, salary adjustment letters, employment changes, probation documentation, and other employee correspondence.

-Organize onboarding and offboarding requirements and coordinate with the relevant stakeholders to complete each step.

-Keep employee files and HR documentation complete, accurate, and up to date.

-Record employee changes appropriately across relevant HR and payroll systems.

-Maintain HR calendars, trackers, checklists, and other tools used to monitor recurring activities and deadlines.

-Assist with recurring and annual People & Culture initiatives.

-Handle confidential employee information responsibly and use appropriate discretion.

-BambooHR & HRIS Management



Take ownership of day-to-day BambooHR administration, including:

-Updating employee profiles and employment information.

-Recording new hires, promotions, compensation changes, employee departures, and other lifecycle updates.

-Managing employee leave and time-off records.

-Keeping organizational and reporting information current.

-Supporting workflows, approvals, documentation, and employee records within BambooHR.

-Assisting with the BambooHR Applicant Tracking System and related recruitment activities.

-Preparing and maintaining HR reports.

-Regularly reviewing HR data to identify incomplete, outdated, or incorrect information.

-Assisting employees and managers with routine BambooHR-related questions.

-Looking for ways to make better use of BambooHR and reduce unnecessary manual HR processes.

-Establishing and maintaining clear procedures for HRIS administration.

-BambooHR experience is highly preferred. Candidates who have administered another HRIS may also be considered if they have strong relevant experience and can quickly adapt to new systems.



Payroll Coordination

-Support payroll administration for employees in the United States and United Kingdom by:

-Preparing and reviewing employee updates that affect payroll.

-Coordinating new employee additions and terminations with payroll.

-Processing salary increases, promotions, bonuses, and other compensation updates.

-Checking that leave and employee status changes are properly reflected in payroll.

-Reviewing payroll information for accuracy before processing.

-Maintaining supporting documentation and securing required internal approvals.

-Investigating discrepancies and coordinating necessary corrections.

-Keeping records of payroll changes and their effective dates.

-Working with Finance, payroll providers, and the Head of People & Culture when required.



Previous experience supporting U.S. and/or UK payroll administration is strongly preferred.

-Leave & Time-Off Support

-Handle the administrative coordination of employee leaves of absence.

-Keep leave-related records, documentation, correspondence, and dates accurate within the HRIS.

-Support maternity, parental, medical, and other applicable leave processes.

-Ensure required approvals and documentation are collected and properly maintained.

-Monitor key leave dates and follow up on outstanding requirements.

-Administer company time-off policies through BambooHR.

-Respond to routine employee questions concerning leave and time-off procedures.

-Escalate complex leave, legal, or employee-relations concerns to the Head of People & Culture.

-Apply leave and time-off procedures consistently according to company policies.



Recruitment Coordination

Provide administrative support across the hiring process, including:

-Arranging interviews across different time zones.

-Coordinating candidate availability with hiring teams.

-Keeping candidate information and recruitment activities updated in the ATS.

-Managing candidate communications during the recruitment process.

-Coordinating interview schedules and following up with interviewers.

-Preparing offer documentation and assisting with the candidate-to-employee transition.

-Coordinating pre-employment and onboarding requirements.

-Maintaining recruitment trackers and monitoring candidate progress.

-Supporting the Head of People & Culture and hiring managers with additional recruitment-related activities.



Training & Compliance

-Manage administrative activities within the company’s employee training platform.

-Assign required training to employees.

-Monitor completion of mandatory and role-specific training.

-Follow up on incomplete training requirements.

-Maintain training records and completion reports.

-Assist with implementing new policies, procedures, and required employee acknowledgements.

-Maintain documentation related to policy acknowledgements and other required records.

-Support compliance monitoring and reporting activities.

-People & Culture Support



The People & Culture inbox will be an important part of your day-to-day responsibilities.

You will:

-Monitor incoming employee and manager requests.

-Ensure questions and requests receive timely responses.

-Handle routine HR and policy-related inquiries when appropriate.

-Direct matters to the appropriate People & Culture team member or internal stakeholder.

-Monitor open requests until they are fully resolved.

-Follow up with employees, managers, or stakeholders when additional information or action is needed.

-Recognize urgent, sensitive, or complex matters and escalate them promptly.

-Help provide employees with a professional, responsive, and supportive People & Culture experience.



HR Policies & Compliance

-Become familiar with the company’s employee handbook, HR policies, and internal procedures.

-Support the consistent application of established HR policies.

-Maintain and update HR templates, documentation, procedures, and employee-facing materials.

-Assist with policy rollouts and employee acknowledgement activities.

-Keep current policy and procedure records organized.

-Prior exposure to U.S. and UK employment practices and employment law is preferred.

-Identify matters that require escalation rather than attempting to independently resolve complex legal or employee-relations issues.



Process Improvement & HR Organization

A key focus of this position is helping create a more organized, efficient, consistent, and scalable People & Culture operation.

You will be expected to:

-Evaluate current HR processes and identify areas where efficiency and accuracy can be improved.

-Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, trackers, and other process documentation.

-Establish repeatable approaches for recurring People & Culture activities.

-Identify manual tasks that can be simplified, standardized, or automated.

-Help clarify ownership and deadlines for recurring HR activities.

-Keep electronic employee and departmental records well organized.

-Make HR information easy to find, understand, and hand over when necessary.

-Monitor outstanding actions and ensure they are followed through to completion.

-Assist the Head of People & Culture with ad hoc projects, reporting, audits, and other operational initiatives.



What We’re Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications:

-At least 2 years of professional experience in Human Resources, People Operations, HR Operations, or a related HR function.

-Strong English communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate HR decisions and information.

-Demonstrated ability to independently manage HR administrative activities such as employee records, documentation, trackers, onboarding/offboarding, training or learning-management platforms, and recurring HR processes.

-Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, including spreadsheets, employee data, reports, trackers, and HR documentation.

-Hands-on experience with an HRIS and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) or employee management system. BambooHR experience is strongly preferred, while comparable HRIS experience may also be considered.

-Excellent attention to HR data accuracy, documentation, organization, and confidentiality, particularly when handling compensation, payroll, leave, and employment information.

-Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to prioritize tasks, solve problems, manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders, and work with minimal supervision.

-Experience using recruitment workflows and Applicant Tracking Systems.

-Experience administering an employee training or learning-management platform.

Ability to work comfortably with spreadsheets, electronic employee records, and data reports.





Working Hours: 6:00 PM – 2:00 AM Philippine Time

Engagement: Full-Time

Setup: 100% Remote

title: # HOLISTIC WELLNESS / MIND-BODY PRACTITIONER
description:
**Remote / Zoom | Part-Time / Sessions | Integrative & Experiential Approaches**



I am looking for an **experienced holistic wellness, mind-body, or therapeutic practitioner** who has broad knowledge of different approaches to emotional well-being, personal transformation, mind-body work, and deeper patterns of the mind.



I am specifically **NOT looking only for traditional talk therapy or CBT**.



I am interested in working with someone who understands approaches that go beyond simply discussing thoughts and can work with **emotions, the body, nervous system, subconscious patterns, internal parts, beliefs, and deeper experiential processes**.



## MODALITIES I AM INTERESTED IN



You do NOT need to practice every modality below. However, I am particularly interested in applicants with professional training or substantial experience in several of these areas:



* **Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work**

* **Somatic approaches / body-based work**

* **Mind-body approaches**

* **Inner-child work**

* Emotional processing

* Nervous-system regulation

* Breathwork

* Meditation and mindfulness

* Guided visualization

* Subconscious beliefs and patterns

* Trauma-informed approaches

* Attachment-oriented approaches

* Emotional-release techniques

* Integrative or holistic psychology

* Hypnotherapy, where appropriately trained

* Yoga / yoga-based therapeutic practices

* Acupuncture / Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge

* Energy-oriented practices or energy healing

* Other legitimate holistic or complementary wellness modalities



I am also interested in practitioners familiar with ideas surrounding **meditation, consciousness, the mind-body connection, visualization, emotional states, and personal transformation**, including some of the themes discussed in the work of **Dr. Joe Dispenza and other mind-body/consciousness teachers**.



However, I am **not looking for someone who simply follows one teacher or repeats spiritual ideas**. I want someone with real training, experience, critical thinking, and a broad understanding of different modalities.



## WHAT I WANT TO LEARN AND EXPERIENCE



Part of my goal is educational.



I want someone who can help me understand:



**What different modalities exist? How do they work? What is each one designed to address? What happens during a session? How are they different from conventional talk therapy?**



Where appropriate to your qualifications and scope of practice, I would also like to **experience and practice different techniques through Zoom sessions**, rather than only hearing about them theoretically.



I am interested in discovering approaches that work with the person on multiple levels — **mind, emotions, body, internal patterns, habits, beliefs, awareness, and overall well-being.**



## WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal person might be a:



* Holistic wellness practitioner

* Mind-body practitioner

* Integrative therapist or counselor

* IFS-informed/trained practitioner

* Somatic practitioner

* Trauma-informed practitioner

* Breathwork practitioner

* Meditation/mindfulness teacher

* Hypnotherapist

* Holistic coach with substantial professional training

* Acupuncture/TCM professional with mind-body knowledge

* Integrative wellness practitioner

* Or someone professionally trained across several related modalities



You should be able to clearly distinguish **which modalities you are formally trained/certified/licensed in, which you have practical experience with, and which you are simply knowledgeable about.**



## IMPORTANT



I value open-mindedness, but I also value **professionalism and honesty**.



Please do not claim that a particular technique can cure a medical or psychological condition unless that claim is within your professional scope and supported appropriately.



If you are not a licensed therapist, psychologist, physician, acupuncturist, or other licensed healthcare professional, that is okay — just clearly state your actual qualifications and professional scope.



I am looking for someone who knows **what they know and what they do not know**.



## ZOOM SESSIONS



Sessions will primarily take place remotely through **Zoom**.



You should be comfortable:



* Teaching and explaining different modalities

* Guiding appropriate exercises remotely

* Giving personalized practices between sessions

* Discussing what we observed during an exercise

* Recommending which approaches may be worth exploring further

* Explaining when something should instead be handled by an appropriately licensed or in-person professional



If a modality genuinely requires in-person treatment — for example, acupuncture — I can work with an appropriate local professional. You can still help educate me about the modality and how it fits into the larger mind-body picture.



## APPLICATION



Please answer the following: 



1. **What is your professional background, education, training, licenses, and certifications?**



2. **Which holistic, therapeutic, somatic, mind-body, or complementary modalities are you professionally trained in?**



3. **Do you have experience with IFS/parts work, somatic work, inner-child work, nervous-system regulation, breathwork, meditation, or subconscious-pattern work? Please explain.**



4. **What other modalities do you know that I did not mention in this job post?**



5. **How do you view the relationship between the mind, emotions, nervous system, body, and behavior?**



6. **Are you familiar with Dr. Joe Dispenza or similar mind-body/consciousness approaches? If yes, please explain your perspective and experience.**



7. **If we worked together, how would you structure our first few Zoom sessions?**



8. **Which techniques can you personally guide through Zoom, and which would require an in-person practitioner?**



9. **Please state your HOURLY RATE or SESSION RATE and the normal length of your sessions.**



### YOUR RATE MUST BE INCLUDED.

**Primary application:** Please apply through **OnlineJobs.ph**.



**Alternative:** You may also contact me directly on **WhatsApp** at:

I am especially interested in finding someone who has studied **multiple approaches**, is deeply curious about the mind-body connection, and can help me explore this field in a **professional, grounded, individualized, and experiential way**.

title: # PROFESSIONAL VOICE TRAINING SPECIALIST / VOCAL COACH – ZOOM
description:

I am looking for an **experienced professional voice training specialist / vocal coach** to work with me one-on-one through **Zoom**.



My goal is to improve my voice as much as realistically possible — including making it **clearer, stronger, more pleasant, better controlled, more confident, and more professional-sounding**.



This is **NOT simply a singing teacher position**. I am specifically looking for someone who understands the **voice itself** and can professionally assess and train an individual's voice.



## WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



You should have strong professional knowledge and experience in areas such as:



* Vocal training and voice development

* **Vocal and throat anatomy**

* Breathing and breath support

* Vocal production

* Resonance

* Projection

* Pitch and pitch control

* Tone and vocal quality

* Articulation and clarity

* Vocal placement

* Voice strength and control

* Proper vocal technique

* Identifying weaknesses in a person's voice

* Creating exercises specifically for an individual's needs



You should be able to **listen carefully to my voice, identify what can be improved, explain what is happening, and create a structured training program to work on it.**



## ZOOM TRAINING



Training will primarily be done **one-on-one through Zoom**.



You should be comfortable demonstrating exercises remotely, listening carefully, correcting technique, and giving clear instructions that I can practice between sessions.



I am looking for someone who can develop a **personalized practice routine** rather than simply following a generic lesson plan.



If there are certain things that genuinely require an in-person professional, I can arrange that separately locally. The primary training will be done remotely.



## IMPORTANT



I am looking for a **professional**, not someone who simply enjoys singing or has casual experience.



Professional voice coaching, vocal training, singing instruction, speech/voice training, or related professional experience is strongly preferred.



A strong understanding of **vocal/throat anatomy and how the voice physically works** is particularly important.



You should also be able to explain the *reason* behind the exercises you recommend.



## EXPERIENCE



Please tell me:



* How many years you have professionally trained voices

* What type of clients/students you normally work with

* Whether you specialize in singing, speaking voice, vocal development, or multiple areas

* Your experience conducting voice training through Zoom

* Any particularly difficult voice-development cases you have successfully worked with



## APPLICATION — PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR RATE



**Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph.**



In your application, answer all of the following:



1. **Tell me about your professional voice-training experience.**

2. **How strong is your knowledge of vocal/throat anatomy?**

3. **What areas of the voice do you specialize in?**

4. **How would you approach improving someone's voice through Zoom?**

5. **What would you normally assess during the first session?**

7. **Please provide your HOURLY RATE or SESSION RATE.**

8. **How long is one standard training session?**

9. **Do you offer a trial/first session? If so, what is the price?**



### IMPORTANT:



**You MUST state how much you charge in your application.**



Applications without a clear hourly or session rate may not be considered.



Please also provide a **website, profile, video, portfolio, or other evidence of your professional voice-training experience if available.**



I am looking for someone who is **professional, knowledgeable, patient, detail-oriented, and genuinely interested in helping me maximize the quality of my voice.**

description:
### Looking for Someone Who Understands the Mind, Subconscious & Mind-Body Connection



**Remote | One-on-One | Zoom**



I am looking for an **excellent psychologist, therapist, mental-health coach, holistic life coach, or integrative wellness practitioner** who has deep knowledge of **personal transformation, subconscious patterns, emotional conditioning, behavior change, and mind-body approaches.**



I am currently healthy and am **not looking for treatment of a mental-health disorder or diagnosis.**



My goal is **personal growth and meaningful change**.



I want to become more motivated, improve how I represent myself, develop better habits and behaviors, overcome patterns that may be holding me back, and become the best version of myself.



## WHAT MAKES THIS POSITION DIFFERENT



I am looking for someone with a **deep and broad understanding of different approaches to personal transformation**, rather than someone who relies on only one standard therapeutic method.



For example, I am very interested in approaches such as:



* Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work

* Somatic and body-based approaches

* Inner-child work

* Hypnotherapy

* EFT / Tapping

* EMDR, when appropriately trained

* Meditation and mindfulness

* Breathwork

* Nervous-system regulation

* Subconscious and emotional-pattern work

* Visualization

* Mind-body approaches

* Trauma-informed approaches

* Attachment and relational approaches

* Neuroplasticity and habit change

* Other experiential, integrative, holistic, or consciousness-based approaches



**These are examples, not a required checklist.**



If you know other powerful modalities or approaches that I have not mentioned, I want to hear about them.



In fact, discovering approaches I **don't already know about** is part of what I am looking for.



## 🧠 DEPTH OF KNOWLEDGE IS IMPORTANT



I want someone who understands the deeper relationship between:



**thoughts → emotions → nervous system → brain → subconscious/implicit patterns → behavior → habits → identity → change**



Knowledge of areas such as the **amygdala, subconscious processes, conditioning, neuroplasticity, habit formation, emotional learning, and behavior change** is a strong advantage.



I am also interested in the broader **mind-body and consciousness field**.



If you are familiar with **Dr. Joe Dispenza's work**, meditation approaches, visualization, emotional-state work, or similar mind-body/consciousness teachings, that is a major plus.



You do not need to follow any particular teacher or agree with every theory.



I am looking for someone who can **understand these ideas intelligently, explain them clearly, and distinguish established evidence from theories, interpretations, or spiritual concepts.**



## 🎯 I WANT AN ACTUAL PLAN



The biggest thing I am looking for is someone who can take all this knowledge and turn it into **practical personal development.**



I don't simply want to have conversations every week.



I want someone who can help me:



* Identify the areas I want to change

* Understand the patterns behind them

* Determine which approaches may be useful

* Create a personalized plan

* Give me specific exercises and practices

* Set realistic goals

Calendar and track deadlines and follow-up dates

Ability to work independently and manage multiple matters

Webcam

Paralegal, legal assistant, law, or related educational background

Experience communicating directly with U.S. law-firm clients

What We Are Looking For



This position is best suited for someone seeking a long-term role with a U.S. law firm who takes ownership of assigned work.



We value:



Reliability and consistent attendance

Accuracy and careful attention to detail

Initiative

Responsiveness

Strong follow-through

Ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, and potential problems without waiting for someone else to point them out



This is an operational legal-assistant position. A substantial portion of the work involves immigration forms, document collection and review, data entry, client follow-up, telephone calls, deadlines, and case-management responsibilities.



Candidates primarily interested in academic legal research or attorney-level legal work should understand that the primary responsibilities of this position are legal-assistant and paralegal support functions.
